title: Senior Web Developer & SEO Specialist (HIPAA Healthcare, Luxury Brand)
description:
Senior Web Developer & SEO Specialist: HIPAA-Compliant Luxury Healthcare Site (Remote, Contract)



About Caldwell Private Health



SEE THE WEBSITE TO UNDERSTAND - 



Caldwell Private Health (
) is a private, membership-based men's health practice serving high-performing men across South Florida: founders, CEOs, and executives. Members get physician-supervised hormone optimization, at-home lab draws, a 90-minute physician consultation, quarterly lab reviews, compounded medications shipped to their door, and personal training and nutrition coaching.



Our brand sits closer to private banking than to a clinic. Everything a member touches must feel luxury, discreet, and effortless.



**Brand system:** Navy (#0F1B2D), gold (#C9A84C), cream (#F0EBE0). Typography: Cormorant Garamond + Montserrat. Tagline: *Performance. Precision. Discretion.*



Who We Need



This is not a template job. You must be equally strong in all three areas below. If you are strong in only one of them, please don't apply.



1. Healthcare-grade security.** You have shipped HIPAA-compliant web applications. You understand the HIPAA Security Rule, Business Associate Agreements (BAAs), encryption at rest and in transit, access controls, audit logging, and secure coding.

2. **Luxury front-end design and development.** Your portfolio proves your taste.

3. **SEO.** You can show real ranking results, including local SEO.



## The Core Principle: Security Is Built In, Not Added Later



Our current site was built quickly using AI-assisted tools. Our healthcare attorney has advised that AI-generated code and unvetted open-source frameworks are the most dangerous way to build a site that touches patient data. We expect to **rebuild the site from the ground up with HIPAA encryption as a core design requirement**, not patch the existing code.



Please apply only if you agree with that approach and know how to execute it.



## Scope of Work



Phase 1: Audit, Architecture & Competitor Review (together with the founder)**

- Do a full security, design, accessibility, and SEO audit of the current site (known issues are listed at the end of this post).

- Review 5–10 competitor and aspirational sites (concierge medicine, men's health, longevity clinics, luxury service brands). Deliver a written report covering what they do well, where we win, and what to adopt.

- Deliver a written architecture plan before any code is written. It must cover:

  - the stack

  - the hosting

  - how patient data flows

  - where data is encrypted

  - which vendors sign BAAs

  - the dependency list

  - the migration path



Phase 2: HIPAA-Compliant Build

- Encrypt any patient data the site touches, both in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256).

- Host on HIPAA-eligible cloud tiers (AWS or Azure) under a signed BAA.

- Prototype cheaply first, then migrate to the production HIPAA tier. Document the migration plan from day one so nothing needs to be rebuilt.

- Replace all forms that collect health information (intake, symptom questionnaire, assessment) with HIPAA-compliant handling covered by a BAA. Formspree must be removed.

- Keep tracking pixels, analytics, session recorders, and chat widgets off any page or form that collects health information. Recommend compliant analytics and ad-tracking alternatives.

- Follow secure-coding standards:

  - Use a minimal set of vetted, actively maintained dependencies.

  - Run dependency vulnerability scanning.

  - Follow the OWASP Top 10.

  - Set security headers (CSP, HSTS).

  - Add rate limiting and bot protection on all forms.

  - Store secrets properly, never in code.

- Use least-privilege access. You work in collaborator and staging accounts and never see or store patient data.

- Personally review and test all code. AI coding tools may be used only if every line is reviewed. Disclose your process.



Phase 3: Luxury Design & Front-End

- Rebuild and elevate every section, fixing every issue in the audit.

- Make the site pixel-perfect on desktop, tablet, and mobile, with mobile as the priority.

- Execute it like a luxury brand: refined motion, generous whitespace, fast video, no layout shift, and one consistent call-to-action path.

- Achieve Lighthouse scores of 90+ in Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO.



Phase 4: ADA / Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)

- Full screen-reader support (tested with VoiceOver and NVDA).

- Full keyboard navigation with visible focus states.

- Color contrast that passes AA, including gold on cream, which must be checked.

- Descriptive alt text on all images, and captions on all video.

- Proper heading structure, form labels, and error messages.

- An accessibility statement page.



Phase 5: Legal Pages & Enrollment Flow

- **Two separate pages: a Privacy Policy AND a Notice of Privacy Practices (NPP).** They must never be combined. Also a Terms of Use page and a medical disclaimer. All of these are linked in the footer and on every form.

- Our attorney provides the documents. You implement them exactly as written.

- The Membership Agreement (which carries HIPAA language) is not a website page, but it must plug into the enrollment flow. Enrollment follows this order: application → agreement e-signed through a HIPAA-compliant e-sign provider → payment → onboarding in our CRM (GoHighLevel) and our EHR .

- Every step must be secure, logged, and seamless for the member.



Phase 6: SEO

- Technical SEO: schema markup (MedicalBusiness, Physician, FAQ), sitemap, canonical tags, Core Web Vitals, meta tags, and designed social share images.

- Move from a single page to a proper site architecture: service pages (TRT, hormone optimization, labs, coaching), location pages (Fort Lauderdale, Miami, Boca Raton, West Palm Beach), a physician page, and blog and podcast templates.

- Local SEO, including Google Business Profile, consistent business name/address/phone details across listings, and citations.

- Set up Google Search Console and compliant analytics, with monthly reporting.



**Phase 7: Handover or Ongoing Management**

- **Option A (handover):** Full documentation, including architecture, credentials transfer, and a BAA/vendor list. Also a recorded walkthrough and a 30-day support window.

- **Option B (retainer):** Monthly management covering security patching, uptime and security monitoring, SEO, content publishing, and monthly reports. Please quote this separately.



Requirements



- 5+ years of web development experience.

- At least one shipped HIPAA-compliant project. Be ready to explain its architecture.

- Hands-on experience with HIPAA-eligible AWS or Azure services.

- WCAG 2.1 AA experience, with audited examples.

- A portfolio of premium or luxury sites.

- Proven SEO results with numbers.

- Fluent written English, and at least 3–4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time.

- Willing to sign an NDA, an independent contractor agreement, and a BAA if required.

- GoHighLevel experience is a plus.



How to Apply



Send the following:

1. Links to 2–3 luxury or premium sites you built.

2. A short description of a HIPAA-compliant project you built: the stack, the hosting, how you handled encryption, and which vendors signed BAAs.

3. One SEO result, with numbers.

4. Five specific issues you see on 
.

5. A fixed-price quote for Phases 1–6, and a monthly rate for Phase 7.

6. Start the first line of your message with the word **"Reserve"**.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid test task and a technical interview.



Appendix: Known Issues on the Current Site



Security & compliance

- Formspree handles health-related form data and does not sign a BAA.

- The site was built with AI tools, and the codebase and dependencies are unvetted.

- There are no Privacy Policy, NPP, Terms, medical disclaimer, or accessibility statement links in the footer.

- Some claims need legal review: "compounded specifically for you," "direct access 24/7," and outcome promises.



Design & UX

- Three different CTA labels ("Request Access," "See If You Qualify," "Book Your Assessment") point to two different destinations.

- The About, Services, and How It Works links all jump to the same anchor (#what).

- Vimeo player controls (speed menu, unmute) appear on the hero video instead of a clean background loop.

- Step images are duplicated in the markup.

- Stray hyphens break sentences ("-your hormones," "-what's off," "-not mass-produced"). Rewrite them as clean sentences with no dashes.

- The hero subline is weak ("Full picture of your health with your personal physician").

- The physician bio is too long for the page and mentions treating women, which is off-brand for a men's practice.

- The stats strip may run labels together ("1-on-1Physician Access").

- The decorative "Reserve Member Card" has no function.

- The footer has no phone,
, or address.



Accessibility

- Alt text is generic ("Step 1") and duplicated.

- The hero video has no captions control or pause control.

- Gold-on-cream contrast likely fails AA.



SEO

- The site is a single page, so it can't rank for separate services or cities.

- The body text never mentions "TRT" or "testosterone," even though the title and meta description target them.

- The H1 has no keywords.

- The share image is the raw logo PNG (2727×1405) instead of a designed 1200×630 card.

- Business name, address, and phone are missing, and there is no schema markup.

-  Be looking for a long-term position and ideally aim to work with us for at least two years.

-  Competitive salary

title: Customer Service Representative – Homecare Operations
description:
# Customer Service Representative – Homecare Operations  

**Registered Nurse Experience Required**



**Join our mission to help seniors live longer, healthier, and happier lives at home.**



We are looking for a capable, compassionate, and highly organized **Customer Service Representative with prior Registered Nurse experience** to support our Homecare Sales, Client Services, and Caregiver Recruitment teams.



This is **not a traditional nursing position**.



You do not need to be currently working as a nurse or maintain an active RN license. However, you should have **real professional experience working as a Registered Nurse**, preferably in the Philippines.



Your nursing background gives you something very valuable in this role: the ability to understand people, listen carefully, recognize concerns, communicate clearly, and help families navigate important decisions about care.



If you are an experienced nurse who is ready to apply your knowledge in a broader business and customer-service role, this may be a strong fit.



## What You’ll Do



### Help Families Find the Right Care



You will often be one of the first people families speak with when they are considering homecare for a parent or loved one.



You will:



- Speak with prospective clients and families with empathy, professionalism, and confidence

- Handle pre-screened calls transferred from our Care Coordination team

- Help families understand the next steps in starting homecare services

- Schedule consultations directly into our calendar system

- Follow up thoughtfully with families who are interested but not yet ready to move forward

- Build trust through clear, responsive, and respectful communication



### Support Our Caregiver Recruitment Team



You will also assist with caregiver recruitment and communication, including:



- Following up with caregiver applicants

- Helping coordinate interviews and next steps

- Maintaining organized recruitment records

- Supporting communication between Recruiting, HR, Scheduling, and Operations



### Become Part of the Homecare Operations Team



This position provides exposure to multiple parts of a growing homecare organization.



You may assist with:



- Customer service

- Sales support

- Marketing follow-up

- Scheduling

- Care coordination

- Caregiver recruitment

- Administrative tasks

- Billing and payroll support

- Data tracking and spreadsheets



You will learn and use systems such as:



- **Wel
rsonal Care**

- **Google Workspace**

- **Google Calendar**

- **Google Sheets**

- **Microsoft Excel**

- CRM and communication systems

- Other homecare technology platforms



## Who We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who brings more than nursing knowledge.



You should be someone who is comfortable communicating with people, learning technology, solving problems, and taking responsibility for getting things done.



### Required



- Previous professional experience working as a **Registered Nurse**

- Strong spoken and written English

- Excellent communication and customer-service skills

- Comfortable speaking with clients, families, caregivers, and applicants

- Strong computer and technology skills

- Good organizational and follow-up habits

- Detail-oriented and dependable

- Comfortable learning new systems and processes

title: Full-Time SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
# Full-Time SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist

**Local SEO | Website Optimization | Google Business Profile | Lead Generation**



We are a growing home care company with a clear mission:



**Help seniors live longer, healthier, and more independent lives in their own homes.**



We are building for the long term.



Our marketing is measured by real business outcomes — not likes, impressions, vanity metrics, or activity that looks productive without generating results.



We are hiring a **full-time SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist** to work directly with our internal team.



This is a **direct-hire position**.



It is not an agency role, not a freelance project, and not a side job.



We are looking for someone who wants to become part of our organization, understand our business deeply, take ownership of results, and improve our marketing systems over time.



## Your Primary Goal



Your main responsibility is straightforward:



**Increase qualified inbound phone calls and inquiries from families looking for home care services.**



Everything else supports that goal.



Traffic matters only if it leads to the right people contacting us.



Rankings matter only if they improve visibility with prospective clients.



Marketing matters only if it produces measurable business results.



## What You Will Own



### Website Management & Optimization



You will help continuously improve our website by:



- Updating and improving website pages and content

- Managing WordPress or a similar CMS

- Improving site speed and mobile performance

- Improving usability and conversion flow

- Identifying and correcting technical SEO issues

- Fixing broken links, indexing problems, page structure, and other technical issues

- Identifying pages that are underperforming and improving them



### Local SEO



You will help us improve local search visibility throughout our service areas.



Responsibilities include:



- Keyword research based on **search intent**

- Identifying keywords that generate calls and inquiries rather than traffic alone

- On-page SEO

- Page titles and meta descriptions

- Header structure

- Internal linking

- Content optimization

- Local service-area optimization

- Monitoring rankings and making adjustments based on performance

- Supporting appropriate citations and local directory consistency



### Landing Pages & Conversion Optimization



You will:



- Build and improve service pages and landing pages

- Develop location-specific pages where appropriate

- Improve calls-to-action and messaging

- Analyze conversion performance

- Make changes based on actual results rather than assumptions

- Help turn website visitors into qualified inquiries



### Google Business Profile Management



You will manage and improve our Google Business Profiles, including:



- Profile optimization

- Posts and updates

- Photos

- Service and business information

- Review monitoring

- Review-response support

- Tracking calls, website clicks, and direction requests

- Monitoring local map visibility

- Identifying opportunities to improve local search performance



### Call-Driven Digital Marketing



We operate a local service business.



That means **phone calls matter.**



You will help us understand which marketing activities actually create qualified conversations.



This may include:



- Supporting Google Ads and other digital campaigns

- Improving ad landing pages

- Assisting with call-tracking systems

- Tracking where calls and inquiries originate

- Reviewing lead quality

- Identifying campaigns and keywords that generate good inquiries

- Identifying campaigns that waste money

- Improving messaging based on actual client conversations and lead quality



## Reporting & Accountability



We expect clear, useful weekly reporting.



We do not want large reports filled with numbers nobody uses.



We want to know:



- How many qualified inquiries were generated?

- How many phone calls were generated?

- Where did those inquiries come from?

- What improved?

- What declined?

- What worked?

- What did not work?

- What did you change?

- What should we do next?



Your weekly reporting may include:



- Calls generated

- Inquiry volume

- Website performance

- Organic search performance

- Google Business Profile activity

- Ranking changes

- Landing-page performance

- Issues discovered

- Work completed

- Next priorities



## What We Value



We are looking for someone who:



- Focuses on **results rather than activity**

- Understands that traffic without conversion has limited value

- Executes without constant supervision

- Thinks in systems and repeatable processes

- Looks for the root cause of problems

- Takes ownership of their work

- Pays close attention to details

- Communicates clearly and honestly

- Is comfortable being measured on real outcomes

- Can explain technical issues in understandable language

- Continues improving rather than simply maintaining what already exists



We especially value someone who is comfortable saying:



**“This is not working. Here is why, and here is what I recommend we change.”**



We would rather identify a problem early and fix it than receive a polished report explaining poor results later.



## Required Experience



You should have hands-on experience with:



- WordPress or a similar CMS

- Local SEO

- On-page SEO

- Google Business Profiles

- Google Search Console

- Google Analytics

- Keyword research

- Landing-page optimization

- SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar

- Call tracking or lead tracking



Experience working with a **local service business** is strongly preferred.



Experience with home care, senior care, healthcare, or another phone-driven business is a plus.



## This Role Is NOT For You If



This position is probably not a fit if:



- Your primary experience is social-media posting

- You primarily focus on followers, likes, or impressions

- You rely heavily on spammy backlinks or questionable SEO shortcuts

- You prefer discussing strategy instead of implementing it

- You need constant direction before taking action

- You are looking for a temporary project

- You are an agency or outsourcing company

- You plan to subcontract the work to someone else

- You are currently managing several employers or clients and intend to continue doing so



## Full-Time Commitment



This is a **full-time, dedicated position**.



If hired, this is expected to be your **primary full-time employment**.



We are not looking for someone who is simultaneously working multiple full-time jobs or servicing multiple clients during their scheduled working hours with us.



We want someone who can give the role their professional attention, become deeply familiar with our organization, and grow with the company over the long term.



## Role Structure



- Full-time

- Remote / Virtual

- Direct hire

- Individual applicants only

- No agencies

- No outsourcing teams

- Long-term opportunity

- Consistent working schedule

- Performance-focused

- Opportunity for increased responsibility based on results



## Application Process



We pay attention to how candidates follow instructions.



### Step 1 — Initial Application



Please provide:



1. A short summary of your relevant experience



2. At least **two examples** of websites you have worked on



3. Examples of Google Business Profiles you have managed



4. Examples of SEO work that produced actual calls, leads, or inquiries



5. In **five sentences or less**, answer:



**How would you increase qualified phone calls for a local home care company?**



6. List the marketing, SEO, analytics, and call-tracking tools you regularly use



7. Confirm the following:



**“I am applying as an individual, not as an agency or outsourcing company.”**



8. Also confirm:



**“If hired, this will be my primary full-time position, and I will not work another full-time job or service other clients during my scheduled working hours.”**



### Step 2 — Paid Skills Assessment



Selected candidates may be invited to complete a short **paid practical assessment**.



This is a real-world task designed to evaluate how you think and execute.



You may be asked to:



- Review a service page

- Identify SEO problems

- Identify conversion problems

- Recommend practical improvements

- Rewrite a section of website content

- Provide a short action plan



We use this assessment to evaluate:



- How you analyze problems

- How clearly you communicate

- Whether you prioritize correctly

- Whether you can execute

- Whether you focus on outcomes rather than theory



**We do not ask candidates to perform unpaid work.**



## Final Note



We are building a stable, long-term marketing system.



We are not interested in hacks, shortcuts, inflated numbers, or activity for the sake of activity.



We want someone who can become a trusted part of our team, take responsibility for an important business function, and continuously improve results.



If you take ownership, execute consistently, communicate honestly, and focus on generating qualified inquiries, **this role can grow significantly over time.**



### One Final Instruction



If you have read this entire job posting, include the word:



**GEMINI**



in the subject line or title of your application.



Applications that do not include **GEMINI** may not be reviewed.

About Us



We are an 8 figure DTC supplement brand. We're growing fast and spend heavily on Meta. Our team is small, fully remote, and spread across different time zones. We move quickly, test a lot of ideas, and let results tell us what works.



The Role



We're looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to lead the thinking behind our ads. You won't be editing videos or designing graphics. You'll be the person who figures out what we should make and why.



Your day-to-day is research and writing. You'll study ads from other brands, figure out what's making them successful, and turn those insights into scripts and concepts that our editors bring to life. If you're the type of person who can spend hours breaking down why one ad works and another doesn't, and then write something better, this role is for you.



What You'll Do



Research competitor ads daily using tools like Meta Ad Library and Foreplay. By hand, not copy-pasted from AI.



Write ad scripts and creative briefs across different angles (health benefits, lifestyle, personal transformation, etc.).



Come up with hooks, storylines, and visual ideas for video ads.



Work with our video editors and designers over Slack and ClickUp to get concepts produced.



Look at ad performance data and use it to d
 what to make next. More of what's working, less of what's not.



Learn our brand, our product, and our customer inside out so your writing sounds natural and authentic.



Keep a running collection of great ads you find and stay on top of what's trending.



Who You Are



You need to have:



Experience writing ad copy or creative concepts for an online brand, even if it was your own.



A feel for what makes people stop scrolling and actually pay attention.



Strong English writing skills. You sound like a real person, not a robot.



A genuine love for research. You enjoy digging into ads, watching them over and over, and picking apart what makes them tick.



The ability to work on your own without someone checking in every hour. We communicate async, mostly Slack and ClickUp.



Bonus if you have:



Experience in health, wellness, or supplements.



Compensation



Please include your desired monthly salary in USD with your application.



Bonus pay when your concepts perform well. The better your ideas do, the more you earn.



This is a real, long-term position, not a test project or short-term gig.



Work Setup



100% remote, work from wherever you want.



Async communication. Very few meetings, mostly Slack messages and ClickUp tasks.



Short weekly check-ins with the founder, but your daily work is self-directed.



Fast-moving team. We trust you to manage your own time and hit your deliverables.



What Matters to Us



Depth over speed. We'd rather have 8 carefully researched concepts than 20 rushed ones.



Results over aesthetics. A "pretty" ad that doesn't sell is worthless to us.



Initiative. You don't sit around waiting to be told what to work on. You find the opportunities yourself.



Honesty. If something's not working, just say it. No egos here.

Apply through the link below.

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
You will be the right hand to a U.S.-based Chairman and CEO of a Nasdaq-listed healthcare company who also runs several private investment and holding entities and an active personal life. This is not a general virtual assistant role. You will own his calendar, inbox and travel end to end, run point on a constant stream of documents, signatures, vendors and follow-ups across multiple companies, and act as the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. You will work directly with him every day, alongside senior executives, board members, bankers, lawyers and investors.



The right person is highly organized, unflappable, discreet, and comfortable making judgment calls without waiting to be told. You anticipate rather than react, you write clean professional English, and you treat confidentiality as non-negotiable.



What you will do:



• Calendar and scheduling. Own a complex, fast-moving calendar across multiple companies and time zones. Schedule and reschedule meetings, resolve conflicts, protect focus time, and make sure every meeting has a purpose, an agenda and the right materials.

•
 and communications. Triage a high-volume inbox, draft replies in his voice, flag what needs his attention, and keep a running list of open items so nothing waits on a forgotten
.

• Travel. Book flights, hotels, cars and restaurants; build detailed itineraries; handle changes in real time when plans move.

• Documents and signatures. Route contracts, board materials, subscription documents and other paperwork for review and e-signature; track what is outstanding; file everything so it can be found in seconds.

• Follow-up and coordination. Keep vendors, advisors and counterparties moving: chase responses, confirm deliverables, and escalate when something is stuck.

• Meeting support. Prepare briefing notes before meetings, take notes and capture action items during them, and circulate follow-ups afterward.

• Personal support. Handle personal logistics such as appointments, household vendors, family calendar items, gifts and reservations with the same rigor as business tasks.

• Expenses and administration. Process expenses, track subscriptions and recurring payments, and coordinate with accountants and bookkeepers across entities.

• Systems and tooling. Build simple systems and checklists that make the operation run more smoothly over time, and use AI tools to draft, summarize and organize faster.



What we are looking for



• At least 4 years supporting a C-level executive, founder or business owner, ideally a U.S.- or Western-based principal, with at least 2 of those years in a remote setting.

• Excellent written and spoken English. You will draft
s that go out under his name and speak with senior people on his behalf.

• Exceptional organization and attention to detail. You keep lists, you close loops, and you notice when a date, a name or a number is wrong.

• Sound judgment and discretion. You will see sensitive financial, legal, medical-business and personal information every day and must handle it accordingly.

• Calm under pressure and comfortable with ambiguity. Priorities change quickly; you re-plan without drama.

• Fluent with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, Zoom, Slack, DocuSign or similar, and travel booking tools. Comfortable learning new software fast, including AI assistants.

• Able and willing to work U.S. Eastern business hours (see below) on a sustained basis, with a quiet dedicated workspace, a reliable computer, backup internet and backup power.

• A plus: experience in healthcare, finance or investment settings; experience supporting someone who runs more than one company; bookkeeping or expense-management familiarity.



Hours and setup



This is a full-time role, 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, working approximately 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time (roughly 8:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m. Manila time; one hour earlier during U.S. daylight saving time). Occasional flexibility outside those hours is expected when travel or a deal is in motion, and it will be reciprocated. You will be engaged as an independent contractor and paid monthly in U.S. dollars.



Compensation and benefits



USD $1,800 to $2,500 per month, depending on experience, with the top of the range reserved for candidates with substantial C-suite experience supporting U.S. principals. In addition:

• A monthly health (HMO) allowance.

• Performance review and compensation adjustment after 6 months, then annually.

title: Media Buyer (Google Ads + Meta Ads)
description:
This is Us

Sona Visual is a content creation and marketing team based in Calgary, Canada, with a growing footprint in Canada and US. For over a decade we've built a name for ourselves in real estate marketing, and we're now expanding what we do for our clients beyond photography and video into full-funnel digital marketing, including paid ads.

We move fast, we're hands-on, and we care about getting real results for our clients, not just clicks and impressions. If you like owning something end to end and seeing your work turn directly into leads and revenue for real businesses, keep reading.



The Role

We're hiring an in-house Media Buyer to become our go-to expert on Google Ads, Meta Ads, and paid advertising more broadly. This isn't a "run a few campaigns and check back in a month" role. You'll be managing live ad accounts for real clients (real estate agents and brokerages, home builders, renovation companies, and home services businesses), and for Sona Visual itself, with real budgets and real accountability for cost per lead and return on ad spend.



Over time, this role is meant to grow into the person our whole team and our clients go to for paid media strategy, not just execution.



What You'll Own

• Build, launch, and manage Google Ads campaigns (Search, Performance Max, Local Services Ads where applicable) and Meta Ads campaigns 
 and Instagram) for multiple client accounts at once

• Handle campaign structure, keyword and audience targeting, ad copy and creative direction, budget pacing, and bid strategy

• Track and report on cost per lead, cost per acquisition, and ROAS, and translate that into plain-English recommendations for clients and for our internal team

• Set up and maintain conversion tracking (Google Tag Manager, call tracking, form submissions, Meta Pixel/Conversions API) so the numbers we report are numbers we can trust

• Stay on top of platform changes across Google, Meta, and other ad platforms (TikTok, LinkedIn, Microsoft Ads) and bring in new channels when they make sense for a client

• Collaborate with our SEO, content, and account management team so paid and organic efforts are pulling in the same direction

• Flag underperforming campaigns early and pitch the fix, rather than waiting to be asked



A Bit About You

You've run paid ad campaigns with your own hands, not just watched someone else do it. You know the difference between a campaign that looks fine and a campaign that's actually making money, and you're comfortable saying so even when the answer isn't what a client wants to hear.



You're organized enough to manage several ad accounts at once without letting any of them go stale, and curious enough that you're already testing new features and formats before your clients ask about them.



Qualifications

• Proven, hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns with real budgets (please be ready to walk us through actual account results or a portfolio, screenshots and anonymized case studies are fine)

• Solid understanding of conversion tracking and attribution: Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Meta Pixel/CAPI, call tracking

• Experience with, or strong working knowledge of, real estate, home building, renovations, or home services marketing (this industry's ad strategy is different from ecommerce or SaaS, and we need someone who already gets that)

• Comfortable with reporting and dashboards (Looker Studio or similar) and can explain performance in terms a business owner cares about, not just platform jargon

• Strong written English for ad copy and client-facing reporting

• Reliable internet, a proper work setup, and the discipline to manage your own time as a fully remote team member

Nice to Have (Bonus Points)

• Agency experience, where you were juggling multiple client accounts and multiple industries at once

• Experience with GoHighLevel or another CRM/marketing automation platform

• Experience with Local Services Ads or other real-estate and home-services-specific ad products

• Basic comfort in WordPress (our clients' sites run on it)

• A track record of scaling a campaign's budget while holding or improving ROAS, not just spending more



Compensation & Schedule

• Full-time, remote position

• Pay: $800 to $1,200 USD/month, based on experience and demonstrated results

• Schedule: Monday to Friday, with at least a few hours of overlap with Calgary, Canada business hours (Mountain Time, UTC-7/-6)

• This is meant to be a long-term seat on our team, not a short-term contract; we're looking to invest in whoever takes this role as our in-house paid media expert



How to Apply

Please apply with:

• Your resume

• A short note on your Google Ads and Meta Ads experience, including which industries you've worked in and roughly what budgets you've managed

• Any portfolio, case studies, or anonymized account screenshots that show real campaign results (this matters more to us than certifications)

• To confirm you read this whole posting, please start your application with the words "Ready to Buy" in the subject line



We review every application personally, so take the time to show us real work rather than a generic template.

title: Senior Telephony Engineer (Telnyx Call Control) to build production-grade voicemail detection for our live transfer
description:
About us

Myra is a sales operations platform for agencies and their clients: lead capture, automations, calendars, messaging, and a calling system with live transfers. When a new lead comes in, Myra phones them within seconds, plays a short greeting, and connects them to a sales agent. Live transfer works well and is in daily use by paying customers.



The problem we need solved

Voi
s. When the lead's phone goes to voi
, our agents get connected to a recording instead of a person. We have had answering machine detection (AMD) switched off because every version we tried was not reliable enough: Telnyx's built-in AMD contradicted itself on roughly a quarter of calls, and once we made the greeting play instantly on answer, the AMD verdict arrived too late to act on. We have spent two months on this without getting it to production quality. We want someone who has solved this before to own it end to end.



What "done" looks like



Voi
s almost never reach an agent (target: under 3% of transferred calls).

Real people are almost never hung up on by mistake (target: under 1%). This matters more than the first target: when unsure, connect the human.

The decision is made within about three seconds of answer, without the lead hearing dead air.

It is measurable: every call logs the signals used and the decision, so accuracy can be reported weekly against what actually happened on the call.

It is safe to roll out: shadow mode first (decide and log, but take no action), then enabled per customer behind a flag, then default on.

Documented and handed over so our team can maintain it.



Our stack



Telnyx Call Control (voice), Telnyx messaging

TypeScript throughout: TanStack Start on Cloudflare Workers, Supabase (Postgres, edge functions, pg_cron)

Built and deployed via Lovable with the repo on GitHub; you will work through pull requests reviewed before publish

Call recordings and transcripts available for evaluation



What you will do



Review the current live transfer flow and the previous AMD attempts (we have the data on what went wrong).

Design the detection approach. We have a preferred direction (a short prompt to the lead, speech detection on the reply, Telnyx beep detection and real-time transcription as signals, AMD as a hint only, a scoring decision with a hard time limit that defaults to human) but we want your judgement.

Build it behind a feature flag with full instrumentation.

Run it in shadow mode on real traffic, measure against recordings, tune until the targets are met.

Roll it out gradually and hand over with documentation.



You must have



Deep, hands-on experience with Telnyx Call Control (or Twilio Programmable Voice with a clear plan for Telnyx): call legs, bridging, media, webhooks, timing.

Prior production experience with answering machine or voi
 detection, and honest numbers on how accurate it was.

Strong TypeScript/Node, Postgres, and webhook-driven systems.

Production discipline: feature flags, logging, shadow rollouts, and the instinct to never break a working call path.

Comfortable working in an existing codebase you did not write.



Nice to have



Real-time speech-to-text (Deepgram, AssemblyAI, Google STT) over streaming audio.

Cloudflare Workers and Supabase.

Experience with dialler or contact-centre products.



Engagement



Contract, exclusively on this feature; no other tickets.

Working hours: 7 AM to 12 PM Pacific, Monday to Friday, with daily check-ins.

Expected duration: 4 to 6 weeks including the shadow-mode measurement period.

Hourly or fixed milestones (design, shadow mode, rollout); tell us which you prefer.

If this goes well, we are looking to offer a full-time position to the right person.



To apply, answer these in your proposal



Describe a voi
 or answering machine detection system you shipped: the approach, the accuracy you measured, and what it got wrong.

How would you resolve the conflict between playing a greeting instantly and needing a few seconds of audio to decide?

Have you worked with Telnyx Call Control directly? Give an example.

Start the first line of your proposal with the word "Telnyx" so we know you read this.



Proposals that are generic or do not answer the questions will not be considered.

title: Homeowner Outreach Specialist — Real Estate Acquisitions
description:
I run an off-market real estate acquisitions business. Every day we're calling homeowners who might be open to selling. Your job is to find out if they're interested and, if so, get them on my calendar for a follow-up call. Nothing to sell, nothing to close. Just qualify and book.



Day to day:



You'll dial using our auto-dialer, which queues up multiple numbers at once, so there's no manual dialing or looking up numbers yourself

Work our script. Open with whether they'd consider selling, work through the first round of pushback if they hesitate, and lock in an appointment on my calendar if there's genuine interest

After every call, log clean notes covering motivation, property condition, timeframe, and price expectations. We shorthand this as MCTP, and it's what makes an appointment actually useful to me

If anyone asks to be put on Do Not Call, flag it immediately. This is non-negotiable, every time

You'll have a daily number of dials to hit and a weekly target for appointments booked, both covered in training



What I need from you:



Spoken English that's fluent and easy to understand. This is a phones-all-day role

A quiet setup with stable internet and a headset, no background noise

Thick skin. Most people will say no, and that's just the job, keep dialing

Someone coachable. Before you go live, we'll walk through everything together on a shared screen

title: FULL-STACK DEVELOPER NEEDED: CUSTOM INTERNAL OPERATIONS DASHBOARD + API/AUTOMATION INTEGRATIONS
description:
FULL-STACK DEVELOPER NEEDED: CUSTOM INTERNAL OPERATIONS DASHBOARD + API/AUTOMATION INTEGRATIONS



About ASE & Co.



ASE & Co. is a growing credit services company. We currently manage our operations through Client Dispute Manager (CDM), Google Sheets, GoHighLevel, Zapier/automation tools, and other systems.



We already have an established operational workflow. We are NOT looking for someone to build a simple website or a basic visual dashboard.



We need an experienced full-stack developer to turn our existing Google Sheets-based operations system into a clean, secure, multi-user internal web application for our team.



What We Are Building



We need a custom internal operations web application / dispute management dashboard for our team.



The current Google Sheet contains our operational workflow, including:



* Master client database

* Client status

* Current dispute round

* Previous/current dispute letter

* Results

* Date sent

* Next round due date

* Weekly work queues

* Overdue clients

* Assigned dispute specialist

* Prepared By

* Billing/login blockers

* Missing documents

* FTC tracking

* Notes/reasons work was not completed

* Status tracking

* Existing scripts and automations

*
 notifications

* Manual recovery/re-run processes



The new application should provide a much cleaner interface while preserving the existing business logic and workflow.



IMPORTANT: We do NOT want to lose the functionality currently working in our Google Sheet.



Before making changes, you will need to understand the existing spreadsheet structure, scripts, automations, and workflow and map them into the new application.



Core Requirements



You must be experienced with:



* Full-stack web application development

* Internal business dashboards

* Google Sheets API

* Google Apps Script

* REST APIs

* Webhooks

* API integrations

* GoHighLevel

* Zapier

* Authentication/user logins

* User roles and permissions

* Databases

* Automation workflows

* Error handling and logging

* Responsive web applications



Experience with Supabase/PostgreSQL, React/Next.js, Node.js, or similar modern full-stack technologies is strongly preferred.



Integrations



A major part of this project is making our different business systems communicate with each other.



The application needs to be designed so we can integrate with:



* Client Dispute Manager (CDM)

* Google Sheets

* GoHighLevel

* Zapier

* Webhooks

*
/notification systems

* Other APIs as needed



We need the architecture to support both real-time integrations and automated/scheduled syncing where appropriate.



For example, when something happens in one system, it should be possible to automatically send/update information in another system.



We do NOT want a standalone dashboard that is disconnected from our other business systems.



Examples of Functionality



The dashboard should eventually allow our team to:



* See all active clients

* See clients due this week

* See overdue clients

* See the current dispute round

* See previous dispute history

* See results

* See assigned specialist

* See blockers such as billing, login, missing documents, etc.

* Filter by specialist, status, round, due date, and blocker

* Update client/work status

* Record completed work

* Automatically calculate the next due date

* Maintain historical records

* Trigger appropriate automations

* Maintain an audit/history of changes

* Send or trigger notifications where appropriate



Existing System



We already have a functioning Google Sheets system with scripts and automations.



You will NOT be starting from a blank page.



Your first responsibility will be to:



1. Review the existing Google Sheet.

2. Understand every important tab.

3. Review the existing Apps Script/automation logic.

4. Understand how CDM feeds information into the system.

5. Map the current workflow.

6. Identify what should remain in Google Sheets and what should move into the new application.

7. Propose the best architecture before development begins.



We are open to improving the architecture if you can explain why, but we do not want existing functionality removed simply because a new technology is being introduced.



Security



This is an internal business application containing private client/business information.



The application must include appropriate:



* Secure authentication

* User roles/permissions

* Secure API credentials

* Environment variables/secrets management

* Database security

* Access controls

* Error logging

* Backup/recovery considerations



What We Are NOT Looking For



Please do NOT apply if your main experience is:



* WordPress websites

* Landing pages

* Graphic design

* Basic HTML/CSS

* Canva/web design

* Building static dashboards with no backend

* Creating mockups without functional applications



We need someone who can build the actual working application and integrations, not just the design.



Required Experience



Please send:



1. Examples of internal dashboards, admin panels, or business web applications you have personally built.

2. Examples of API integrations you have built.

3. Your experience with GoHighLevel.

4. Your experience with Zapier, Make, or n8n.

5. Your experience with Google Sheets API / Google Apps Script.

6. Your preferred full-stack technology stack.

7. Your experience with databases such as Supabase/PostgreSQL.

8. How you would approach converting an existing Google Sheets workflow into a web application without disrupting the current operation.

9. Your estimated timeline for an initial working version.

10. Your hourly rate or fixed-project estimate.



IMPORTANT APPLICATION QUESTION



Please answer this specifically:



If we currently have a Google Sheet containing our client database, weekly queues, formulas, Apps Script automations, due-date logic, overdue logic, and status workflows, how would you turn that into a secure multi-user web application while keeping the existing system operational during development?



Please explain your approach in simple terms.



Project Structure



We are open to starting with a paid discovery/prototype phase before committing to the complete build.



The right developer may have the opportunity for ongoing development and maintenance as we continue expanding our internal systems.



We are looking for someone who thinks like a systems developer, not just someone who follows a design.



You should be able to look at an existing business process, understand how the pieces communicate, identify potential problems, and recommend the best technical solution.



Please do not send a generic application. Applications without relevant examples and answers to the questions above will not be considered.

title: DTC Creative Strategist
description:
We run direct response ecommerce brands on paid social. Creative is the only real lever left, and creative only works when it is built on genuine customer understanding rather than guesswork.



We are hiring one person to sit alongside the founder every day and own the research-to-script pipeline. You dig into the market, find out what customers actually feel and fear and want, turn that into new angles and avatars, and produce the scripts and briefs our editors turn into ads. The founder handles the ad account and feeds you the results. Your job is to work out what those results mean and what we do next.



This is not a coordination role. You are not managing a calendar or chasing assets. You are the person who finds the insight and writes the thing.



What you will actually do



Deep customer research



Mine voice of customer at volume: Reddit threads, Amazon and competitor reviews (especially the one and two star ones), YouTube and TikTok comment sections,
 groups, forums, Quora, post-purchase surveys, support tickets, our own ad comment sections.

Pull direct language out of it. Not summaries. The exact phrasing people use when they describe the problem to a friend.

Build and maintain a swipe of pain points, emotional triggers, objections, purchase anxieties, failed prior solutions, and the specific moment that pushes someone from tolerating the problem to buying a fix.

Run and interpret real customer research: surveys, buyer interviews, post-purchase questionnaires, review analysis. You should be comfortable getting on a call with a customer and asking the uncomfortable follow-up question.

Segment what you find into distinct avatars with distinct triggers, not one blurred "target customer."



Competitor and market research



Systematic teardowns of every meaningful competitor: their ad library, their creative formats, which ads have been running longest and at what volume, their funnel, their landing pages, their offer, their pricing, their review sentiment, their weak points.

Track what is scaling in adjacent categories and steal the structure, not the copy.

Identify where the market is in terms of sophistication and awareness, and what that means for the claims we can make and the way we have to open an ad.

Find the gaps. Where is every competitor saying the same thing, and what is the unclaimed position.



Angles and avatars



Generate new angles continuously. Most will die. That is expected. We want volume of genuine swings, each one traceable back to a specific piece of evidence.

Every angle comes with a rationale: which avatar, which pain point, which awareness stage, which competitor claim it displaces, why now.

Develop and articulate mechanisms. Why does this product work, explained in a way that is concrete, ownable and believable rather than generic.



We read every application properly, so we expect the same in return. Start your application with the answer to 4+4 on the first line, nothing else on that line. Anything without it goes in the bin unread.



Scripts and briefs



Write ad scripts for static, UGC, talking head and b-roll voiceover formats. Written to be spoken, not written to be read.

Write briefs our editors can execute without coming back with questions: reference material, pacing, on-screen text, b-roll requirements, tone, and what the ad is actually trying to do.

Write and iterate primary text, headlines, hooks, and supporting funnel copy including advertorials, listicles and landing page sections.

Produce hook variations at volume and understand the difference between testing a hook and testing an ad.



Creative feedback loop



You will not be in the ad account. The founder reports the results back to you: what spent, what converted, hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS.

Your job is the diagnosis. Given those numbers, why did this ad win or lose, and is the problem the hook, the angle, the avatar, the proof, the offer or the format.

Turn every test into a documented learning about the customer, not just a verdict on the ad.

Maintain the creative learning log so we stop relearning the same lesson, and translate each learning into the next round of scripts.

What we are looking for



Non-negotiable



You have written ad creative that has spent real money on Meta and you can explain what worked and why.

You can research. Genuinely research. Not read three Reddit threads and write a persona document full of adjectives.

You write in spoken language. If your copy sounds like marketing, it will not survive here.

You understand direct response fundamentals: mass desire, market sophistication, awareness stages, mechanism, proof, objection handling. Familiarity with Schwartz's Breakthrough Advertising is a strong signal, and we will assume you have read it.

You can take a set of reported metrics and reason from them accurately. You do not need to be a media buyer, but you need to know what a high hook rate with a dead CTR is telling you.

You work fast and iterate without ego. Creative gets killed here on data, not on taste.

You are self-directed. We will tell you the objective, not the steps.

Excellent written English and a good ear for regional voice differences across AU, NZ, UK, US and CA.



Strong advantage



Experience with competitive intelligence and scraping tools (ad library tools, review scrapers, comment scrapers, AI research workflows).

Comfort with AI tooling as a research and production accelerant, paired with the judgment to know when its output is generic filler.

Experience briefing editors and knowing what is realistic to produce.

Background in one of: supplements, consumer hardware, home and auto, pet, or another problem-solution physical product category.

Basic ability to build or mock up static creative concepts so briefs are unambiguous.



Not a fit if



You need a detailed brief before you can start.

Your research process is asking an AI for a customer persona.

You think great creative is a matter of opinion.

You want to work on brand awareness, brand books, or anything that cannot be measured within seven days.

How we work

Daily contact with the founder. Fast async communication, short calls, no meeting theatre.

We test in structured rounds with clean variables. One meaningful change per cell wherever possible.

Every recommendation is expected to carry its evidence. "I think" is fine, as long as it is followed by "because customers in this segment keep saying X."

Premium positioning standard across everything we produce. Direct response discipline, but nothing that looks or sounds cheap.

title: SEO Engineer
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Technical SEO Developer who can implement SEO changes directly, not just recommend them.



This role is for someone comfortable working inside CMS files, templates, and codebases to improve crawlability, performance, and keyword rankings. If your experience is mainly content SEO, reporting, or tool-based optimization, this role will not be a good fit.



What You Will Do

 • Audit and implement technical SEO fixes related to:

 • Crawlability and indexation

 • Site architecture and internal linking

 • Canonicalization and rendering issues

 • Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile performance

 • Work directly within:

 • WordPress (themes, plugins, core files)

 • Shopify (Liquid templates, SEO constraints, performance)

 • PHP-based platforms (e.g. OpenCart or similar)

 • Implement structured data and technical enhancements at code level

 • Optimize websites for traditional search and AI-driven search experiences (GEO / GSEO)

 • Take ownership of ranking performance and SEO KPIs

 • Use SEO tools to diagnose issues, but rely on implementation, not automation alone



Required Skills & Experience

 • 3+ years of hands-on technical SEO implementation

 • Comfortable editing live websites and templates

 • Working knowledge of:

 • HTML, CSS, JavaScript (rendering understanding required)

 • PHP and Shopify Liquid

 • Experience working directly inside:

 • WordPress, Shopify, and PHP-based e-commerce platforms

 • Strong understanding of:

 • Google Search Console

 • Ahrefs / Semrush

 • Screaming Frog, Lighthouse, GTmetrix

 • Able to clearly explain why SEO actions are taken and how they affect rankings

 • Good command of spoken and written English



Nice to Have

 • Experience with SQL or Python / Node.js for SEO automation

 • Practical exposure to Generative Engine Optimization (GEO / AI search)

 • Proven examples of technical changes leading to ranking improvements



Important Notes

 • This is not a strategy-only or reporting-only role

 • Candidates who rely mainly on plugins, widgets, or third-party apps without understanding the underlying technical mechanics will not be suitable

 • You must be comfortable implementing changes yourself

title: Instagram content creator (Canva + Reels) for Australian wellness clinic. AHPRA/TGA-safe execution only
description:
About the business

LIVN IV is a Gold Coast, Australia mobile IV therapy service run by a Registered Nurse. The brand is premium, youthful, and energetic — not hospital-clinical. Instagram is a core channel. All content must follow Australian AHPRA advertising rules and TGA rules for health services and therapeutic goods. You will not invent medical claims.

The current Instagram needs a full initial overhaul. Existing posts and education slides must be redone and reworded for TGA and AHPRA compliance, then rebuilt into one clean, professional grid. After that, the role is ongoing grid maintenance and new education slides in the same system.



What you will do

•  Overhaul the current feed: restyle and reword existing slides/posts so they are compliant and look like one brand

•  Remake education carousels so the page feels inviting, consistent, and professional (not flyer-style)

•  Design new Instagram carousels, stills, and story frames in Canva from our brand kit

•  Edit short Reels (CapCut or similar) from footage we supply — covers, text overlays, pacing, music

•  Draft captions and on-screen text only from our approved swipe file and themes

•  Build a weekly content calendar and schedule in Meta Business Suite after we approve

•  Light community work: reply to booking questions with scripts we give you; escalate anything clinical

•  Monthly simple Insights screenshot (reach, saves, profile visits) — no ads unless we add that later



What you will not do

•  Publish without written approval (first 90 days: every post)

•  Write educational slides about ingredients, drips, NAD+, peptides, or results from scratch

•  Use client testimonials, reviews, or “after this drip I…” stories

•  Give health advice in DMs or comments

•  Run ads, change pricing, or speak as the clinician



Must-have skills

•  Excellent Canva (carousels that look expensive, not template-spam)

•  CapCut or equivalent Reel editing

•  Written English that sounds natural to an Australian audience (we will test this)

•  Comfortable following a strict word list and asking when unsure

•  Reliable in Slack/WhatsApp and Google Drive



Nice to have

•  Wellness, fitness, or beauty content in your portfolio (not US med-spa “miracle results” work)

•  Experience with Meta Business Suite scheduling

•  Understanding that Australian health ads are stricter than US wellness ads

title: Full-Time Social Media & Brand Manager (Remote)
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced, creative, and highly organized Social Media & Brand Manager to build and manage the online presence of a growing luxury residential construction and real estate brand. This is more than a posting role. You will be responsible for brand strategy, content planning, storytelling, social media management, creative coordination, and eventually buyer/Realtor lead generation.

The initial focus will be documenting the brand's first residential project from Day Zero through completion, with the marketing strategy gradually shifting toward property promotion and sales as the project nears completion.



Key Responsibilities

● Develop weekly and monthly social media strategies and content calendars.

● Manage Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Stories.

● Schedule and publish high-quality content consistently.

● Write engaging, professional, and premium captions and copy.

● Organize project photos, videos, renders, graphics, and marketing assets.

● Coordinate with video editors, graphic designers, photographers, and local content creators.

● Review raw footage and identify opportunities for Reels, TikToks, Shorts, Stories, and carousels.

● Communicate with management about what needs to be filmed and when.

● Document major construction milestones from demolition to completion.

● Maintain a consistent luxury brand identity, tone, and visual style.

● Research relevant trends while maintaining a sophisticated brand image.

● Monitor analytics, engagement, website traffic, inquiries, and leads.

● Maintain an organized database of potential buyers and Realtors.

● Support future property launches, private previews, floor plan releases, and sales campaigns.

● Prepare a concise weekly report covering content, upcoming filming needs, performance, and leads.



Content Pillars

Content should be built around:

1. The Build Demolition, excavation, foundation, framing, rough-ins, insulation, drywall, cabinetry, finishes, landscaping, and completion.

2. Construction Education Waterproofing, framing, insulation, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, windows, structural details, and other behind-the-wall work.

3. Design Kitchens, bathrooms, flooring, cabinets, lighting, fixtures, materials, architectural details, floor plans, and interior/exterior design.

4. Transformation Show the journey from Existing House → Demolition → Construction → Interior → Finished Home.

5. Brand Company philosophy, construction decisions, quality standards, founder/project insights, and behind-the-scenes stories.



Content Targets

Approximately:

● 2 high-quality Reels per week

● 1 carousel/photo post per week

● 3–7 Stories per week

● TikTok and YouTube Shorts adaptations

Quality is more important than quantity.



Capture everything. Post strategically.



Project Documentation

The manager will coordinate content capture for major milestones including:

● Day Zero / Existing Property

● Demolition

● Excavation & Foundation

● Framing

● Rough-ins / Mechanical

● Insulation & Drywall

● Cabinetry & Millwork

● Interior Finishes

● Exterior & Landscaping

● Near Completion

● Final Professional Photography & Video



All footage must be properly organized so it can be reused for future marketing and portfolio content.

Qualifications



● 3–5+ years of experience in social media, content management, digital marketing, or a related role.

● Proven experience managing social media for a business, brand, real estate, construction, architecture, design, or other visual industry.

● Strong knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

● Excellent written and verbal English.

● Strong copywriting, storytelling, and content strategy skills.

● Excellent organization and time management.

● Experience coordinating with creative professionals.

● Ability to analyze social media performance.

● Able to work independently and meet deadlines.

● Strong understanding of professional and luxury brand presentation.

● Reliable high-speed internet and professional remote-work setup.



Preferred

● Experience with luxury real estate, construction, architecture, interior design, or property development.

● Strong understanding of premium visual branding.

● Canva, Adobe, CapCut, or similar tools.

● Meta Business Suite and social analytics.

● Basic video editing and graphic design.

● Google Drive/content asset management.

● Website/WordPress/Webflow experience.

● Lead generation and digital marketing experience.

● Strong visual judgment and short-form storytelling skills.



Important: This is NOT a basic social media posting position.

We are looking for someone who thinks like a Brand Manager and Content Strategist.



You should be able to answer:

What should we film? 

Why should we film it? 

How should we present it? 

When should we publish it? 

What story does it tell? 

How does it strengthen the brand? 

How can it eventually generate buyers and Realtor relationships?



You are expected to proactively identify content opportunities and communicate filming requirements to management.



Growth Opportunities

High-performing candidates may have opportunities to:

● Lead the overall digital brand strategy.

● Manage social media for future projects.

● Lead creative and marketing team members.

● Manage photographers and content creators.

● Participate in property launches and sales campaigns.

● Advance into Senior Brand/Marketing Management.

● Receive performance-based incentives as the company grows.



Why Join?

● 100% remote position.

● Help build a luxury residential brand from the ground up.

● Document a complete residential project from Day Zero to finished home.

● Significant creative and strategic ownership.

● Opportunity to build a long-term portfolio and marketing system.

● Growth opportunities as the company expands into future projects.



How to Apply

Please send to: 

● Updated Resume/CV

● Links to 3–5 social media accounts or brands you have managed

● Portfolio or examples of your work

● 2–3 minute audio introduction

● Brief summary of your content strategy and creative coordination experience

● Brief explanation of why you are interested in the role



Application Questions

1. If demolition begins Monday, what content would you capture before, during, and after?

2. What would your first 30 days of content look like for a new luxury residential brand?

3. How would you turn a normal construction update into an engaging Reel?

4. What luxury brands have excellent social media branding, and why?

5. How would you balance brand building with future buyer and Realtor lead generation?



Subject: Social Media & Brand Manager Application – Your Full Name



Note: Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

title: SEO and GBP specialist
description:
READ FULL POST



About LazyJobber



LazyJobber manages Google Business Profiles for local service businesses, including UK tradespeople (plumbers, electricians, HVAC engineers, builders, roofers) and US car detailers. We optimise listings, handle reviews, and work to improve clients' local map rankings. This role supports that work directly.



The Role

Part-time, remote, 12–25 hrs/week, reviewed after a paid trial (see below). As the business grows hours will grow too. We expect you to start around the 12 hrs/week mark or just below that based on work, then over time (and with business growth) rise up steadily as you take on more client work.



What you'll do

- Manage and optimise Google Business Profiles across multiple client accounts: business info accuracy, categories/services, photos, posts, and Q&A

- Respond to Google reviews on behalf of clients, matching each client's tone and brand voice, and handling both glowing reviews and complaints professionally

- Monitor client profiles regularly and flag new reviews promptly

- Handle local SEO upkeep: NAP consistency checks, citation building/cleanup, spot-checking competitor GBPs

- Assist with keyword research and reporting using data and tools we provide

- Highlight key areas which competitors are doing well and how we can catchup

- Follow our SOPs/checklists for GBP work and log completed tasks (Trello/Sheets/Slack)

- Flag issues or opportunities proactively rather than waiting to be asked



What we're looking for

- Excellent written English: clear, warm, and natural. Copy that sounds robotic or obviously AI-generated is an instant no for this role, since it goes out under a real business's name.

- Some hands-on experience managing Google Business Profiles (agency, freelance, or in-house). Strong generalist VAs with adjacent experience will still be considered if they test well.

- Comfortable running multiple client accounts at once without close supervision

- Reliable internet with a backup plan for outages

- Able to commit 15–25 hrs/week with some overlap for team check-ins across UK and US working hours

- Detail-oriented: mistakes here are public and attached to a real business's name



Nice to have

Familiarity with local SEO tools (BrightLocal, Local Falcon, GMB Everywhere, or similar)

Understanding of citations, NAP consistency, and how local map/3-pack rankings work

Experience working with UK, US, or Australian client bases

Agency or white-label experience managing SEO for multiple clients at once



Hours & pay

12hrs/week to start, flexible day-to-day, with agreed overlap hours for team communication

$4-5/hr USD to start, paid via Wise/Payoneer



Rate reviewed after a paid trial task and again after a 30-day trial period, based on performance



How to apply

To confirm you've read this properly, start your application with the word "GBP SEO" and answer:



Tell us about one Google Business Profile you've personally managed. What did you do, and what changed?

Pick any real local service business's Google Business Profile (a tradesperson, car detailer, or similar) and tell us one thing you'd improve about it. Show us a case study for and highlight areas of improvement.

title: Video Editor & Content Creative Director
description:
We are looking for a creative, self-motivated video editor who understands social media, especially the fitness/bodybuilding niche, and can take raw footage and independently turn it into engaging content.



 We are looking for someone with a strong creative mindset and understanding of what performs well on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.



I will primarily provide you with the raw footage, and I expect you to be able to look through the clips, identify the best moments, and create compelling content from them with minimal direction.



Primary Responsibilities



Short-Form Content



* Edit approximately 3 Instagram Reels/TikToks per week

* Take raw fitness, bodybuilding, lifestyle, coaching, and personal-development footage and turn it into engaging short-form content

* Select the best clips and moments independently

* Create strong hooks, pacing, transitions, captions, text overlays, zooms, sound effects, music, and other elements when appropriate

* Understand current social-media editing styles and what keeps viewers watching

* Make creative decisions without needing step-by-step instructions

* Understand the difference between content that is simply "edited" and content that is actually engaging and designed for social media**



Long-Form YouTube Content



* Edit YouTube vlogs, fitness videos, bodybuilding content, coaching content, and other long-form videos

* Organize large amounts of raw footage and create a cohesive, entertaining final video

* Know how to remove unnecessary footage while maintaining the story and keeping the viewer engaged

* Add appropriate music, B-roll, text, transitions, graphics, and other elements when needed



Instagram Stories & Coaching Content



* Create high-engagement Instagram Story templates to promote my online coaching business

* Use Canva and/or other design software to create professional, attention-grabbing templates

* Create templates for coaching promotions, client transformations, testimonials, calls-to-action, educational content, announcements, and other marketing purposes

* Have a strong understanding of visual marketing and how to make Instagram Stories encourage people to stop, read, and take action

* Be able to take a basic idea and turn it into an attractive, professional-looking design without needing extensive instructions



What I'm Looking For



The most important quality I'm looking for is CREATIVITY.



I don't want someone who needs to be told exactly where every clip goes, what text to add, what transition to use, or how the video should flow.



I want someone who can receive a folder of raw footage and think:



"I can turn this into something good."



You should have:



* Strong video editing skills

* A creative eye and strong sense of storytelling

* A strong understanding of Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube

* Experience editing fitness/bodybuilding content or a genuine understanding of the niche

* An understanding of social-media trends and audience retention

* The ability to work independently

* Strong attention to detail

* Good judgment when selecting footage, music, text, pacing, and effects

* Basic-to-advanced Canva/design skills

* The ability to consistently meet deadlines

* The ability to take initiative and bring your own ideas to the content



 Ideal Candidate



The ideal person will be someone who doesn't just ask:



"What do you want me to do with these clips?"



Instead, they look at the footage and say:



"Here's what I think we should make."



You should be comfortable making creative decisions and bringing your own ideas to the table. I want an editor who can become familiar with my brand, my personality, my audience, and the fitness niche and eventually understand what type of content fits my brand without needing constant direction.



This will be an ongoing position for the right person, with the potential for additional work as the brand and content output continue to grow.
