title: Amazon Account & PPC Specialist — CPG Food Brand (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
About the Role

We're a growing CPG (consumer packaged goods) food brand selling a specialty baking/dessert ingredient, sold direct-to-consumer online, in national retail stores, and on Amazon. We're looking for an experienced Amazon Account & PPC Specialist to take over day-to-day management of our Amazon business — currently handled by an outside agency — and run it directly, with room to also support advertising on other retail platforms (e.g., Instacart) as that grows. Full company name and brand details will be shared directly with the candidate we move forward with.



This role is focused on the day-to-day management and optimization of Amazon: PPC advertising, marketplace operations, profitability tracking, and performance analysis. We're looking for someone who has previously managed Amazon accounts for CPG, food, or beverage brands, speaks the language fluently, and can work independently to identify opportunities, solve problems, and drive results.



One thing to know before you apply: AI-powered PPC, bid, and analytics tools are fully expected here — that's normal for this work. But our product listing copy, A+ Content, and Storefront are customer-facing, so final versions of those need to be human-edited and true to our actual brand voice, not shipped as raw AI output. See "How we use AI" below.



Work Structure & Requirements

- Location: Remote

- Schedule: Part-time, approximately 10 hours/week

- Time zone: Needs meaningful overlap with US Eastern (EST) business hours for coordination — please note your available hours relative to EST when you apply

- Compensation: $7USD/hour to start, with room to grow based on experience and results 



What you'll do:



Amazon PPC & Performance

- Own day-to-day management and optimization of Amazon PPC campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other relevant ad formats

- Conduct keyword research, search-term analysis, and competitor research

- Optimize bids, budgets, targeting, and campaign structures

- Launch and manage new campaigns and testing initiatives

- Monitor ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CPC, conversion, and overall sales performance

- Track profitability at the ASIN/SKU level, including COGS and FBA fees

- Identify underperforming areas and proactively recommend improvements

- Provide clear, direct weekly reporting on performance, learnings, and recommended next steps



P&L & Profitability Management

- Maintain a clear view of Amazon P&L — revenue, ad spend, FBA fees, COGS, and overall profitability

- Proactively flag margin risks and identify opportunities to improve profitability

- Translate data into clear, actionable recommendations



Listing Optimization & Content

- Review and optimize Amazon product listings — titles, bullet points, imagery, and product content

- Collaborate on A+ Content, video, and creative assets (final customer-facing copy/content is human-reviewed — see "How we use AI" below)

- Maintain and improve our Amazon Storefront

- Keep listings accurate, conversion-focused, and brand-aligned

- Monitor competitor activity and category trends



Retail Media (Other Platforms)

- Support advertising on other relevant retail media platforms as our presence there grows (e.g., Instacart)

- Apply Amazon PPC learnings and best practices across those platforms

- Monitor spend and performance across channels and flag optimization opportunities



Account Health & Operations

- Monitor account health and proactively flag potential issues

- Raise and manage Amazon Seller Support cases through to resolution

- Troubleshoot listing, inventory, fulfillment, and account-related issues

- Support inventory/logistics coordination to help maintain product availability



How we use AI:

We're fully on board with AI-powered tools for PPC bidding, keyword/competitor research, and performance analytics — use whatever makes you faster and sharper at this job. The one place we draw a line is customer-facing content: final product listing copy, A+ Content, and Storefront pages should be human-written or human-edited to sound like us, not raw AI output shipped as-is.



What we're looking for:

- 2+ years of hands-on Amazon marketplace and Amazon PPC experience, ideally managing accounts for CPG, food, or beverage brands — you must provide examples demonstrating measurable results (e.g., ACOS, ROAS, or profitability improvements)

- Demonstrated ability to manage and track Amazon P&L, including profitability at the ASIN/SKU level, COGS, and FBA fees

- Deep fluency with Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Ads, FBA operations, listing optimization, and resolving Seller Support cases

- Clear, direct, concise communicator — comfortable giving straight answers and actionable weekly reports rather than long, indirect updates

- Comfortable analyzing data and turning it into specific, prioritized recommendations

- Highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work independently



Nice to have:

- Hands-on Instacart Ads experience (campaign setup, optimization, performance management)

- Meta Ads experience

- Familiarity with Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar tools

- Comfortable with Google Workspace and Slack



To apply:

Please send your resume, 2–3 examples of measurable Amazon results you've driven (ACOS/ROAS/profitability improvements), and a short video introduction. Applications without examples of previous work will not be considered.

About the Role

MyIT Tutor is an online one-to-one tutoring company expanding its presence internationally. We're looking for a creative, reliable and organised Social Media Content Creator to join our marketing team and produce consistent, high-quality social content across Instagram,
 and YouTube (with LinkedIn where relevant).

This is a part-time, outcome-based role — we care about the content you deliver, not hours logged or a fixed schedule. Do the agreed work well and on time, and how/when you do it is up to you. If your throughput is strong and efficient, there's room to grow the rate and the workload over time.

This is a content production role — you won't be setting marketing strategy. Instead, our marketing/SEO team will hand you clear briefs, campaign ideas and content themes, and you'll turn them into polished, on-brand, platform-ready social assets. If you love taking a brief and making it look great — rather than deciding the strategy yourself — this is for you.

Our audience is international, not the Philippines — you'll be creating content for parents, students and tutors in our overseas markets, adapting to their local curriculum and exam context, so research skills and adaptability matter as much as design polish.

We're looking for someone who wants a long-term, ongoing role and is happy to grow with the company over time — this isn't a short-term or one-off project.

• Follow our established brand colours, fonts, logo and visual identity consistently

• Work from an agreed content calendar and hit production deadlines

• Keep design files, videos and assets clearly organised and version-labelled

What We're Looking For

Essential:

• Strong written English

• Competent in at least two other internationally used languages, in addition to English

• Confident, professional design skills in Canva

• A genuine portfolio of social media/content work you've personally created

• Ability to create professional Instagram posts and carousels

• Ability to follow an established brand identity precisely (not introduce your own style)

• Comfortable working to deadlines and providing status updates

• Experience working with a content calendar

• Experience working with international/overseas brands or clients

Tools You'll Use

Canva · CapCut (or equivalent) · Google Drive/Docs/Sheets · basic scheduling tools

Working Arrangement

• Outcome-based, not hours-based — we're paying for agreed deliverables done well and on time, not for time logged

• Meetings and check-ins scheduled at times that work for both sides

Recruitment Process

1. Application & portfolio review — we'll assess your existing, previously published work

2. Video interview — communication, English, and a walkthrough of your own past work

3. Final interview — role fit, availability, and rate/contract terms

How to Apply

Send your CV and a portfolio link (Canva/Instagram/Behance/Drive folder — whatever shows real, finished work you've personally created, not templates or mockups). Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

This is a working Operations Manager seat, not a dashboard job. About half your week you oversee a small remote CS/ops team. If you want to invent 50 KPIs, build scorecards nobody uses, and "monitor" instead of close — stop here. We already tried that. We need a doer with brain power: escalate cleanly when you must, d

s/chats/calls and coach on specifics

Building how we work

Reporting to ownership

• Weekly: what moved, what didn't, what needs a decision from us

• Bring decisions and options — not a wall of KPIs



Who this is for

• 2+ years managing or supervising people with real performance responsibility (hard conversations, documentation)

• You've finished hard ops cases yourself — not only delegated them

• E-commerce operations experience (Shopify or similar) strongly preferred

• Comfortable with numbers enough to spot what's wrong and act — not to invent vanity metrics

Strongly preferred

• Chargebacks / payment disputes

Not a fit if

• You consider hands-on work beneath you

• Your first move is a 50-metric dashboard instead of closing the open case

• You've only managed by being liked

• AI or template applications



PAY

$1,700–$2,000 USD per month · full-time · 40 hours · long-term

Start toward $1,700; room in band as you prove you finish hard work and lead the desk.



Hours: 40 hours/week, US Eastern, Monday–Friday.



How to apply

Skip any item → closed unread.



1) First word: ANVIL

Then why THIS seat (hands-on ops manager, not pure manager) fits you right now.



2) Hard case you finished: One escalation, chargeback, freight/claim, marketplace, or property mess you personally closed. What did you open first? What did you d
? How did it end?



3) Leadership without theater: Team size. One time you coached or documented poor performance. What changed?



4) SOP gap: Work that had no clear procedure — what did you write or change so the next person could finish it?



Attach: resume · speed-test screenshot · backup power and/or backup internet · hours you can work in Philippines time aligned to US Eastern.



One long-term seat. Finishers with judgment — not KPI collectors.

title: Authorization Coordinator Assistant
description:
We are a leading healthcare organization committed to providing exceptional patient care and improving the health and well-being of our communities. As a Remote Authorization Department Associate, you will play a crucial role in ensuring timely and accurate authorizations for our patients, enabling them to access the care they need.



**Responsibilities:**



As a Remote Authorization Department Associate, you will be responsible for handling various tasks related to authorizations and communicating with regional managing partners and clinicians via our communication platforms. Your primary duties will include:



1. **Answering Incoming Phone Calls:** Respond to incoming phone calls promptly and professionally, addressing inquiries related to authorizations, status updates, and general information regarding the department's processes.



2. **Follow-up Phone Calls:** Initiate follow-up phone calls on requested authorizations already in process. Communicate with patients, insurance companies, and healthcare providers to ensure smooth processing and timely approval of authorizations.



3. **Requesting New Authorizations:** Initiate and manage the process of obtaining new authorizations from insurance companies or relevant parties for upcoming patient treatments, or services.



4. **Tracking Authorization Expiration Dates:** Maintain a meticulous record of all current authorizations and their expiration dates. Proactively work to renew authorizations before they lapse, ensuring continuous patient care.



5. **Communication with Regional Managing Partners and Clinicians:** Collaborate with regional managing partners and clinicians to keep them informed about the approval or denial status of patient authorizations. Provide necessary updates and coordinate solutions in case of denials.



6. **Documentation and Data Entry:** Accurately document all communication, actions taken and relevant information related to authorizations in the department's database or electronic health records system.



7. **Adherence to Compliance:** Follow strict protocols and guidelines to ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements regarding patient privacy and authorization processes.



8. **Process Improvement:** Continuously identify opportunities to streamline and improve the authorization process, contributing to the overall efficiency and effectiveness of the department.



**Qualifications:**



- High school diploma or equivalent; some college coursework in healthcare administration or related fields is a plus.

- Previous experience in a healthcare authorization department or related administrative role is preferred.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a strong ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely.

- Proficiency in using computer systems, databases, and google suite applications.

- Detail-oriented and organized with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

- Customer-oriented mindset with the ability to handle inquiries and concerns in a compassionate and professional manner.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with various stakeholders.



**Remote Work Requirements:**



This position is fully remote, requiring a reliable internet connection and a quiet, dedicated workspace to ensure efficient communication and execution of responsibilities.

Position to be worked Monday - Friday (8am - 5pm Eastern US Time Zone)

description:
We are looking for a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to call and text inbound leads for our roofing industry clients — booking roof inspections, confirming appointments, and following up after quotes to get a clear decision.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Call and text every inbound lead on a set cadence until they respond — book a roof inspection, or confirm the appointment they already self-booked online



- Work leads through GoHighLevel: keep every lead in the correct pipeline stage, log a note after every single touch, and update deal values when quotes go out



- Handle common objections (timing, decision-maker, budget, and more) using our playbook



- Follow up with homeowners after their quote is delivered to get a clear yes or no (you're not expected to sell the job, just get a decision)



- Leave voi
s and send texts that match our tone — casual and funny. Like chatting with an old friend.



- Document every call: what happened, what you learned, what happens next



REQUIREMENTS

- Fluent, clear spoken English — you'll be on the phone with U.S. or Canadian homeowners all day



- Comfortable making outbound/warm calls and handling "no"



- Reliable internet, a quiet space to take calls, and your own headset



- Available during 9am–2pm Pacific Time, 7 days per week

- This means you'll work 35 hours per week, 150hours per month. The wage is $5/hour



- Detail-oriented — a note gets logged on every lead, every time



- Able to follow a structured script and call cadence closely, especially in the first few weeks





BONUS SKILLS

- Experience with GoHighLevel



- Past experience as an SDR, appointment setter, or telemarketer — home services (roofing, solar, HVAC, remodeling) is a big plus



- Comfortable handling objections over the phone without a script in front of you



- You’re funny



COMPANY CULTURE

LaunchPad is a small, fast-moving marketing agency built for roofing and home service companies. We run the ad campaigns and the follow-up systems that turn those ads into booked jobs.



Our team is made up of young, ambitious people who value growth over compensation.



We’re not here to micromanage or babysit you or find you tasks to do.

You’ll be given the expected results and the resources you’ll need.

But you have to figure out how to use those resources and achieve the end result.



HOW TO APPLY (REQUIRED)

Submit a short Loom video (30–60 seconds) that includes:

- A brief introduction

- Why you're interested in this role (get personal - be cool, be funny, be casual)

- Why even with an accent, you’d crush it (Our clients want local, North American accents. But we tell them the accent doesn’t matter - so you gotta prove that we’re right).

- A quick example of your phone voice. Read one of our sample call openers out loud, or share a clip from a past calling/appointment-setting role



*Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.*

If you obsess over CTR, you like clean and premium over loud and cluttered, and you want a steady client that grows with you, keep reading.





THE QUICK VERSION



- What: Thumbnails for long-form YouTube videos. Talking-head tech content.

- How many: 2–3 videos a week (8–12 a month once we're rolling), with 2–3 variations per video so we can test.

- Pay: Starting around $20 per thumbnail, and I'm flexible for the right person. If your work is next level, tell me your rate. I'd rather pay more for someone great than save money on someone average.

- Turnaround: 24–48 hours from brief to first draft.

- Channel: 





WHY THIS IS A REAL OPPORTUNITY



Thumbnail designers usually get one-off jobs and have to hustle for the next one. This is the opposite. I'm producing 8–12 videos a month indefinitely, and every single one needs your work. That's a steady, predictable client, and I tie your rate to results: when your thumbnails get clicks, your pay goes up.



And there's more coming. I'm building DuoTrack, a fitness app, and I run a personal brand on Instagram and TikTok. Launch graphics, product visuals, social content. The person nailing my thumbnails now gets first look at all of it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO



For each video, I'll send you the title, a short brief on the hook and the angle, a few high-res photos of me (I can shoot specific expressions or poses on request), and any screenshots or assets you need. From there:



- Design 2–3 thumbnail variations per video so we can A/B test.

- Keep it clean and readable. Few words, big and bold. Clear focal point. Readable at phone size. Instantly obvious what the video is about.

- Build and maintain a consistent visual identity for the channel: colors, fonts, layout patterns, how my face and text work together.

- Handle cutouts, background removal, lighting and color on my photos, and sharp product or UI mockups when a video is about a tool.

title: Short-Form Video Editor / TikTok Content Creator/ UGC content — CPG Food Brand (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
About the Company

We're a growing CPG (consumer packaged goods) food brand selling a specialty baking/dessert ingredient. Our product is sold direct-to-consumer online and in national retail stores, and we're now growing our presence on TikTok Shop. Our brand voice is fun, playful, bold, and trendy. We care about authenticity, in our product and in how we show up online — nothing customer-facing that comes out of this role should be AI-generated. Full company name and brand details will be shared directly with the candidate we move forward with.



A growing CPG food brand with an active TikTok presence is looking for a skilled short-form video editor to turn our raw footage into scroll-stopping, UGC-style TikTok and Instagram content. We have raw photos/video organized by product variant and a founder-recorded voiceover track for most videos, and want someone who can take that material and produce polished, on-brand videos we can batch and schedule ahead of time.



One thing to know before you apply: nothing customer-facing here is AI-generated. No AI video, no AI images, no AI voiceover — everything we post is real. See "How we use AI" below.



What you'll do:

- Edit raw photo/video clips (organized by product variant) into finished short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Pinterest,
, and
/X

- Sync in voiceover audio provided by the founder (all voiceover narration is recorded by the founder personally — this is not part of your role), and add trending sounds, captions, and on-screen text in a fun, playful, bold, trendy style

- Write scripts and talking points for the founder to record as voiceover, when asked

- Follow current TikTok/UGC trends and food-content formats and adapt them to fit our products

- Write short, trend-aware, scroll-stopping captions and hooks tied to food/baking trends

- Help plan and manage a content calendar so a batch of content shot in one day can be scheduled out across the following week(s)

- Repurpose one piece of content into multiple formats/platforms to maximize each shoot

- Keep messaging consistent with our core selling points: consistent quality at any batch size, better-for-you ingredients, and strong value/convenience positioning

- Flag which existing videos are performing well so we can double down on similar formats



Why this role matters:

Right now, content output is limited by the founder's time. A dedicated editor turns raw footage and founder-recorded voiceover into a steady, professional-looking stream of content, frees up the founder's time to focus on the business, and lets us actually hit a consistent weekly batch-and-schedule workflow — which should improve watch time, follower growth, and ultimately traffic into our TikTok Shop and online store.



How we use AI:

Every video we post is built from real footage and a real, founder-recorded voiceover — no AI-generated video, images, avatars, or synthetic voiceover, ever. That's a real part of our brand identity, not just a policy. You're welcome to use AI tools for your own workflow — research, trend-spotting, organizing footage — but the final edit, captions, and creative direction need to be real, hand-made work that you stand behind.



What we're looking for:

- A strong portfolio of short-form video edits (TikTok/Reels) — you must provide examples of previous work (please include links)

- Skilled with tools like CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar

- Understanding of what makes food/lifestyle content perform on TikTok (pacing, hooks, trending audio, captions)

- Comfortable working from raw footage, a provided voiceover track, and loose direction, not just a shot list

- Good written English for captions, scripts, and creative suggestions

- Reliable turnaround and comfortable with a weekly batch-delivery schedule



Nice to have:

- Experience creating UGC-style content for food, beverage, or beauty brands

- Basic graphic design skills (Canva or similar) for thumbnails/covers



Schedule & pay:

Part-time, remote, ongoing — starting at approximately 5 hours/week at $5.00/hour, with hours and rate potentially increasing depending on your experience and the results you deliver.



To apply:

Please share your portfolio/reel and tell us your typical turnaround time and hours for a batch of 10–15 short videos. Applications without examples of previous work will not be considered.

title: YouTube Video Editor (Tech & AI)
description:
Hey! I'm Giovanni. I run TechGio, a YouTube channel about tech sales, AI, and building a startup. I'm looking for one talented long-form editor to grow the channel with me. If you love clean, premium talking-head content and you're excited about tech and AI, this one's for you.



THE QUICK VERSION



- What: Long-form YouTube only. Talking-head + screen recordings. No Shorts.

- How many: 2–3 videos a week (8–12 a month once we're rolling)

- Pay: $50–$100 per video based on experience and quality. Roughly $500–$1,000+/month, with raises as your work speaks for itself.

- Turnaround: First cut within 48 hours of getting footage.

- Where: Fully remote. I'm in Houston, Texas. You can be anywhere.

- Channel: 



ABOUT THE CHANNEL



TechGio started as me documenting my own path into tech sales and helping people break in with no experience. I'm an enterprise account executive at a tech company, and that's still the heart of the channel: what the job is really like, earnings breakdowns, day-in-the-life.



Now it's growing. I'm going deeper into AI and the tech industry (new model releases, the tools I actually use, what's changing and what it means for you). And I'm building my own startup on the side, so I'll be sharing the founder journey while working full-time.



I've worked with an editor before and it went great. Now I want more videos, more polish, and one editor who becomes a true long-term partner. Someone who grows with the channel and wins when it wins. Hopefully that's you!



WHAT YOU'LL DO



I batch-film. You get raw footage (Sony A7 IV), screen recordings, and a short brief with the hook, structure, and the moments I want to hit. Then you run the edit:



- Cut it tight. Trim dead air and bad takes, keep the energy up. Retention is the whole game.

- On-screen text and captions. Callouts, key numbers, lists. Sharp and well-timed. This is a big part of the style.

- Simple, polished motion. Diagrams for AI concepts, tool and UI highlights, clean transitions. Think Jeff Su, not MrBeast.

- Screen recording polish. Zooms, cursor highlights, blur anything sensitive.

- Music, sound design, and clean dialogue audio.

- Color, final export, and organized project files.

- Quick revisions from my timestamped notes. Usually one round.



THE STANDARD



Watch a couple of these before you apply so we're on the same page:



- Jeff Su: 
 (the golden example: clean, tight, sharp text, subtle motion, never overdone)

- Liam Ottley: 
 (clear diagrams and callouts that make AI simple)

- Dan Martell: 
 (bold text, strong pacing, premium feel)



If you watched those and thought "I can edit at that level," keep reading.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



- You've edited long-form YouTube talking-head content before, ideally for tech, business, or productivity channels, and you have published videos to prove it.

- Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, plus After Effects or similar. You make text and motion look premium.

- You use AI in your workflow. Descript, auto-captions, the AI features in your editor, whatever works for you. My whole operation runs that way.

- You're into tech and AI, or genuinely curious about it. It shows in the edit when the editor cares.

- Fast and reliable. If something's going to slip, I hear about it before it does. I'll always do the same for you.

- Coachable and hungry. I give clear feedback and I'm easy to work with.

- Fluent English. We'll work mostly async on Slack or WhatsApp.



One honest ask: please don't apply if you're just getting started or if your portfolio is mostly Shorts, gaming, or event videos. Nothing wrong with that work, it's just not this role. I need someone who can hit a high bar from day one.



WHAT YOU GET



- Steady, consistent work. 8–12 videos a month.

- Raises tied to quality. Good work gets rewarded here, I truly mean that.

- Tools covered. Software, plugins, stock music, assets. If you need it to do the job well, I'm happy to help pay for it.

- Room to grow. As the channel and the startup take off, there's going to be a lot more to make. You get first look at all of it.

- A real voice. I want your ideas on pacing, hooks, and style. You're a creative partner here, not just a pair of hands.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word "Mission" so I know you read the whole thing. Then send me:



1. 3 links to long-form YouTube videos you edited, and exactly what you did on each.

2. Your tools, including which AI tools you use.

3. How many 10–15 minute videos per week you can realistically deliver, and your usual first-cut turnaround.

4. Your rate per video.



The strongest applicants get a paid test edit before we commit to anything, so you get paid either way.



I need portfolio links to consider you, so please don't skip those. Can't wait to see what you've made and hopefully build something great together!



— Giovanni

ABOUT THE ROLE



I am an entrepreneur based in Las Vegas building a personal brand around business, lifestyle, personality and personal evolution.



The central story is about an ambitious entrepreneur who spent years focused on building businesses and is now learning to enjoy the life he worked for—without losing his ambition.

I am looking for a creative and highly organized Personal Brand Content Strategist and Social Media Manager who can turn my real life, personality and experiences into compelling short-form content.



This is not a basic posting or Canva-graphics position. You must understand personal branding, storytelling, strong hooks and short-form video strategy.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Develop a weekly content strategy based on my personal brand

• Create short-form video concepts for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

• Write strong hooks, talking prompts, captions and calls to action

• Prepare clear shot lists and filming instructions

• Submit a short weekly performance report with recommendations

THE BRAND DIRECTION



The brand should feel:



• Cinematic

• Ambitious

• Authentic

• Confident

• Unpredictable

• Aspirational but still relatable



The content should combine polished lifestyle footage with raw, personality-driven moments. The goal is not to create a fake “guru” or luxury influencer. The goal is to build a recognizable world around a real entrepreneur and an unfolding personal journey.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



• Proven experience managing a personal brand or creator account

• Strong understanding of Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

• Excellent English writing and communication skills

• Strong understanding of hooks, storytelling and audience retention

Video-editing experience is helpful but not required. This position is primarily focused on strategy, planning, organization, publishing and growth.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



During the first 30 days, we should:

• Build a repeatable weekly filming and publishing system

• Publish approximately 12–20 quality short-form videos

• Identify the strongest content themes, hooks and formats

• Reduce the amount of daily planning required from me

title: Marketing Analytics & Tracking Specialist (GA4/GTM/Ads)
description:
We're looking for a full time, passionate analytics and tracking specialist to join our busy US-based digital marketing agency.



What you'll own



Measurement & tracking

Build and maintain GA4 properties across a portfolio of client sites — event and key event configuration, cross-domain tracking, referral exclusions, channel groupings, filters and data retention

Implement and maintain Google Tag Manager containers: tags, triggers, variables, data layer specs, consent mode, server-side GTM where appropriate

Set up and validate conversion tracking for Google Ads, Meta (Pixel and Conversions API), LinkedIn and other ad platforms, including offline and CRM-sourced conversions

Configure call tracking (CallRail or equivalent) and form/booking tool tracking, including third-party embeds and iframes

Audit inherited accounts and fix what's broken — duplicate tags, inflated engagement metrics, misconfigured key events, broken attribution, self-referrals

Write tracking specs that developers can implement, and QA their work before it goes live

Run tracking QA on every site launch and migration so nothing is lost at go-live



Reporting

Build and maintain Looker Studio dashboards that clients and internal teams actually use

Connect and maintain data sources: GA4, Search Console, Google Ads, Meta, call tracking, CRM

Investigate anomalies and explain them in plain English to account managers and clients

Monitor link profiles for toxic or spammy links and manage disavow files where justified

Audit and clean up existing link profiles on inherited accounts

Track competitor link profiles and identify gaps worth pursuing

Report on link velocity, authority growth and the impact on organic visibility



General

Keep documentation current — naming conventions, container structures, tracking specs, per-client setup notes

Keep task status accurate in ClickUp and communicate blockers early

Contribute to internal SOPs so tracking setups are consistent across the portfolio







What we're looking for



Required

3+ years of hands-on GA4 and Google Tag Manager implementation across multiple sites or clients

Demonstrable experience setting up conversion tracking for Google Ads and Meta, including Conversions API

Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript — enough to read a page, find why a tag isn't firing, and write a custom event or dataLayer push

Experience with Looker Studio (or an equivalent BI tool) building client-facing dashboards

WordPress and/or Shopify experience — enough to install tracking without breaking a theme

Agency background juggling multiple clients and priorities

title: YouTube Thumbnail Designer (Tech & AI)
description:
Hey! I'm Giovanni. I run TechGio, a YouTube channel about tech sales, AI, and building a startup. I'm looking for one talented thumbnail designer to become my go-to for every video. If you obsess over what makes people click and you like clean, premium design over loud clickbait, this one's for you.



THE QUICK VERSION



- What: Thumbnails for long-form YouTube videos. Talking-head tech content.

- How many: 2–3 thumbnails a week (8–12 a month once we're rolling), with 2–3 variations per video so we can test.

- Pay: Starting around $20 per thumbnail, and I'm flexible for the right person. If your work is next level, tell me your rate. I'd rather pay more for someone great than save money on someone average.

- Turnaround: 24 hours from brief to first draft.

- Channel: 



ABOUT THE CHANNEL



TechGio started as me documenting my own path into tech sales and helping people break in with no experience. I'm an enterprise account executive at a tech company, and that's still the heart of the channel: what the job is really like, earnings breakdowns, day-in-the-life.



Now it's growing. I'm going deeper into AI and the tech industry (new model releases, the tools I actually use, what's changing and what it means for you). And I'm building my own startup on the side, so I'll be sharing the founder journey while working full-time.



I'm hiring a dedicated video editor separately. This role is thumbnails only, and I want one person who owns it: someone who learns the channel, builds a consistent look, and gets better with every video as we see what performs.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



For each video, I'll send you the title, a short brief on the hook and the angle, a few high-res photos of me (I can shoot specific expressions or poses on request), and any screenshots or assets you need. From there:



- Design 2–3 thumbnail variations per video so we can A/B test.

- Keep it clean and readable. Few words, big and bold. Clear focal point. Readable at phone size. Instantly obvious what the video is about.

- Build and maintain a consistent visual identity for the channel: colors, fonts, layout patterns, how my face and text work together.

- Handle cutouts, background removal, lighting and color on my photos, and sharp product or UI mockups when a video is about a tool.

- Quick revisions from my notes. Usually one round.

- Deliver final PNGs at 1280x720 plus the editable source files (Photoshop, Figma, or whatever you work in).



THE STANDARD



Go look at the thumbnails on these channels before you apply so we're on the same page:



- Jeff Su: 
 (the golden example: clean, minimal, sharp text, never overdone)

- Ali Abdaal: 
 (bright, friendly, consistent identity across hundreds of videos)

- Dan Martell: 
 (bold text, strong contrast, premium feel)

- Liam Ottley: 
 (makes AI topics look simple and clickable)



Think premium and clear, not MrBeast. If you looked at those and thought "I can do that," keep reading.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



- You've designed YouTube thumbnails for real channels before, ideally tech, business, or productivity, and you can show published examples. Even better if you can point to any that performed well.

- You're strong in Photoshop, Figma, or similar. Clean cutouts, good typography, and you know how to make a face and a few words pop.

- You think about click-through rate, not just "does it look nice." You understand what makes someone stop scrolling.

- You use AI in your workflow where it helps (background removal, generating elements, mockups, whatever). My whole operation runs that way.

- You're into tech and AI, or genuinely curious about it. It shows when the designer understands the topic.

- Fast and reliable. If something's going to slip, I hear about it before it does. I'll always do the same for you.

- Coachable and hungry. I give clear feedback and I'm easy to work with.

- Fluent English. We'll work mostly async on Slack or WhatsApp.



One honest ask: please don't apply if you're just getting started, or if your portfolio is mostly logos, social posts, or general graphic design with no YouTube thumbnails in it. Thumbnails are their own skill. I need someone who already has it.



WHAT YOU GET



- Steady, consistent work. 8–12 thumbnails a month, every month.

- Raises tied to results. If your thumbnails get clicks, your rate goes up. I truly mean that.

- Tools covered. Software, stock assets, fonts. If you need it to do the job well, I'm happy to help pay for it.

- Room to grow. As the channel and the startup take off, there's going to be a lot more to design: launch graphics, product visuals, social content. You get first look at all of it.

- A real voice. I want your ideas on titles, angles, and what to test. You're a creative partner here, not just a pair of hands.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word "Orbit" so I know you read the whole thing. Then send me:



1. 5–10 YouTube thumbnails you designed, with links to the videos they were used on if possible. Tell me what you were going for on each.

2. Your tools, including any AI tools you use.

3. How many thumbnails per week you can realistically deliver, and your usual turnaround.

4. Your rate per thumbnail.



The strongest applicants get a paid test: one real thumbnail for a real video, before we commit to anything. So you get paid either way.



I need to see actual thumbnails to consider you, so please don't skip those. Can't wait to see your work and hopefully build something great together!



— Giovanni

title: Packaging Graphic Designer — Dieline & Print Production (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
About the Company

We're a growing CPG (consumer packaged goods) food brand selling a specialty baking/dessert ingredient. Our product is sold direct-to-consumer online and in national retail stores. Full company name and brand details will be shared directly with the candidate we move forward with.



We're looking for a Packaging Graphic Designer who's comfortable working with dielines and print-ready files to update and maintain our product packaging. You'll take dielines provided by our pouch manufacturer and turn them into finished, print-ready artwork in Adobe Illustrator — keeping our packaging on-brand, accurate, and ready to send straight to print.



What you'll do:

- Take dielines supplied by our pouch/packaging manufacturer and build or update packaging artwork to fit them exactly

- Update existing packaging files (Adobe Illustrator/.ai) when details change — new flavors/variants, updated copy, ingredient or nutrition panel changes, barcodes, certifications, or retailer-specific requirements

- Prepare final files to print specifications: correct bleed, safe zones, CMYK/Pantone color matching, resolution, and file structure per the manufacturer's requirements

- Create new packaging designs for new product launches, working within our existing brand guidelines (colors, logo, fonts, layout style)

- Resize or adapt existing designs across different pouch sizes/formats as needed

- Keep packaging files organized and version-controlled by SKU/flavor so past versions are easy to find

- Communicate directly with our pouch manufacturer/printer as needed to resolve dieline questions or proof issues

- Flag any inconsistencies across our SKUs and help keep packaging visually consistent brand-wide



Why this role matters:

Packaging changes and new flavor launches currently depend on the founder's own limited design time, which slows things down and risks inconsistency across SKUs. A dedicated designer who's fluent in dielines and print production means new flavors and packaging updates can move faster, print-ready files go to the manufacturer with fewer errors or delays, and the brand looks consistent and professional across every product on the shelf.



What we're looking for:

- Strong hands-on experience with Adobe Illustrator, specifically working from manufacturer-supplied dielines

- Understanding of print production requirements: bleed, safe zone, CMYK/Pantone color, resolution, packaging file structure

- Experience with flexible packaging/pouch design specifically is a strong plus (not just general graphic design)

- Sharp attention to detail — small errors in packaging artwork are costly to fix once printed

- Comfortable taking direction and revising designs based on feedback

- Good written English for communicating with our team and, when needed, our manufacturer

- You must provide examples of previous packaging design work (please include links or files/images we can view without needing special software)



Nice to have:

- Experience designing for food or beverage CPG packaging specifically

- Familiarity with common pouch/bag formats (stand-up pouches, flat-bottom bags, etc.)

- Basic knowledge of nutrition facts panel or ingredient label formatting requirements



Schedule & pay:

Gig work, remote, ongoing — starting at approximately  $4.50/hour, with hours and rate potentially increasing depending on your experience and the results you deliver and when packaging changes warrant 



To apply:

Please share 2–3 examples of packaging or dieline-based design work you've done (images or view-only links are fine — please avoid sending files that require downloading or special software to open). Applications without examples of previous work will not be considered.

title: Creative Video Editor & Social Media Growth Specialist
description:
MCAT Simplified is hiring a full-time Creative Video Editor & Content Growth Specialist to help grow our YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok presence.



We help aspiring doctors prepare for the MCAT. We’re looking for a versatile, highly creative editor who can turn newly filmed footage into compelling videos, develop original content ideas, repurpose existing recordings, and use performance data to guide our growth.



You should understand how to make people stop scrolling, feel something, keep watching, and connect with our brand. Strong editing skills, storytelling, creative initiative, and an understanding of social media strategy are essential.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Turn our newly filmed footage into polished, engaging videos with a clear story, strong hook, and satisfying payoff.

• Use captions, our available B-roll, music, sound design, graphics, and thoughtful pacing to strengthen each video.

• Create emotionally compelling content that connects with students’ ambitions, frustrations, challenges, and successes while staying authentic to our brand.

• Work across different formats, including educational videos, talking-head content, motivational storytelling, student success stories, promotional videos, and longer YouTube videos.

• Contribute ideas before filming: suggest concepts, hooks, scripts, talking points, and additional shots that would improve the finished video.

• Identify valuable moments in existing lessons and recordings, then turn them into engaging standalone clips.

• Adapt content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and long-form YouTube rather than using the same approach for every platform.

• Develop compelling title and thumbnail concepts, recurring content series, and new creative approaches.

• Help maintain a consistent flow of high-quality content through organized planning, editing, and delivery.

• Learn our brand voice, products, and audience so your creative decisions support our broader business goals.



PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS & WEEKLY MEETINGS



You will also help us understand what is working and how to improve.



• Review video performance, including views, retention, watch time, click-through rates, shares, saves, and follower growth, where available.

• Come to each weekly team meeting prepared with a concise report showing what was published, how it performed, and what we learned.

• Analyze strong and weak performers, identifying patterns in topics, hooks, storytelling, pacing, and presentation.

• Bring specific recommendations, fresh content ideas, and experiments for the following week.

• Track the results of those experiments and apply what you learn to future videos.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• A versatile portfolio showing original video production from supplied footage, short-form editing, and strong storytelling.

• Excellent creative judgment: you know when to add visual interest, build emotion, simplify an edit, or let a moment breathe.

• Strong skills in captions, B-roll selection, audio editing, music selection, color correction, and basic motion graphics.

• An understanding of audience psychology, platform-specific content, and social media growth.

• The ability to take raw footage and a general direction and independently develop a strong finished video.

• Initiative in proposing ideas and improving our content—not waiting for detailed instructions on every edit.

• Comfort analyzing performance data and presenting useful recommendations.

• Strong English comprehension and attention to accuracy when editing educational content.

• Reliable communication, organization, and the ability to meet deadlines.

• Proficiency in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or comparable software, with reliable equipment and internet access.



Experience helping a brand grow through content is a strong plus. Medical or MCAT knowledge is not required, but curiosity and a willingness to understand our audience are essential.



ROLE DETAILS



• Full-time, remote

• 40 hours per week

• $5 USD per hour

• Weekly team meetings



HOW TO APPLY



Use “MCAT Creative Editor” as your application subject and include:



A brief introduction explaining why you fit this combination of editing, creativity, and content strategy.

Links to 3–5 videos demonstrating your range. Include at least one video you built from raw footage and explain your contribution.

Any measurable content performance or growth results, including the timeframe and your role.

Two original video ideas for MCAT Simplified, with a suggested hook and editing approach for each.

A brief example of how you used analytics to improve content.

Your editing software, availability, time zone, and confirmation that the hours and pay work for you.



We want someone who takes ownership of their creative work and is excited to help us build content that resonates with students and grows our brand.

## What I'm Looking For

Edit one YouTube video per week, 15 to 30 minutes long. Clean cuts, tight pacing, no fluff. I'm after minimalist, elevated, premium-feeling edits, not flashy transitions or gimmicks.

Cut each long-form video into 3 short-form pieces (Reels/TikTok/YT Shorts) for extra reach.

Tools We Use



- Descript (editing)

- Google Drive / Dropbox



 You Are



- Experienced editing YouTube long-form content

- Creative and proactive. You suggest better cuts, don't just wait to be told

- A self-starter who works ahead of schedule

- Reliable. Deadlines are deadlines, not suggestions

- An excellent communicator who flags issues early, not after the deadline's passed

- Interested in wellness, coaching, or nurse-led businesses (a bonus!)

What You'll Get

title: Short-Form Reels Editor (Personal Brand)
description:
Hey! I'm Giovanni. I'm building my personal brand on Instagram and TikTok, and I'm looking for one editor to team up with me on it for the long haul. If you love short-form content, you're fast, and you want to grow with someone instead of bouncing between gigs, this one's for you.



THE QUICK VERSION



- What: Instagram Reels and TikToks. Talking-head "yapping" videos, get-ready-with-me, and day-in-the-life.

- How many: About one reel a day to start, with room to grow to two.

- Pay: $10–$20 per reel based on experience and quality, with raises as we grow.

- Turnaround: 24 hours from raw footage to first cut.

- Tools: Instagram Edits app ideally, CapCut works too. We'll work in Slack.

- My page: 



ABOUT THE BRAND



My personal page is where I share the real stuff: my thoughts, my mornings, the gym, the grind of building something while working full-time. Raw, real, and consistent. Also make fitness content here. 



This is a brand-new push. I'm committing to posting every single day, and I need an editing partner who's just as committed. I don't need you to be a 10-year pro. I need someone with a good eye, real short-form experience, and the hunger to get great. I'll train you on exactly how I want things edited (I have a full style guide), and once you've got it, you run with it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



I'll film and send you raw footage every day through Slack, plus a quick note on the hook and the point of the video. From there:



- Cut it tight. Trim the pauses and rambling, keep the energy up, hook in the first second.

- Captions and on-screen text. Clean, well-timed, in our brand style. This is a big part of the look.

- Simple, tasteful edits. Zooms, cuts, B-roll placement, sound. Enough to hold attention, never overdone.

- Two styles: raw talking-head yapping reels, and GRWM or day-in-the-life vlogs with timestamps and title cards.

- Export ready-to-post, 9:16, so I can post to Reels, TikTok, and Shorts.

- Quick tweaks from my notes. Usually one round, often none.



THE STANDARD



Go look at these before you apply so we're on the same page:




 (super engaging, feels real, great pacing)


 (clean lifestyle and GRWM style)


 (raw, personality-first talking-head content)


 (the golden example for raw yapping reels. Our style guide is built around this.)



If you watched those and thought "I can edit like that, and I'd love to," keep reading.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



- You've edited short-form content before (Reels, TikToks, or Shorts) and you can show me examples. Doesn't have to be for a big account.

- You know the Instagram Edits app, or you're strong in CapCut. Either works, Edits is a plus.

- You're passionate about short-form. You watch Reels and notice why they work. You have opinions on hooks and pacing.

- You're comfortable in Slack and you're responsive. We'll talk every day.

- Fast and reliable. 24-hour turnarounds, and if something's going to slip, I hear about it before it does. I'll always do the same for you.

- Coachable. I'll train you on my style and give clear feedback, and you actually apply it.

- Fluent English, and you get the vibe of lifestyle and self-improvement content.



Please don't apply if you're looking for a quick one-off gig. This is a daily, long-term thing and I want someone who's excited about that.



WHAT YOU GET



- Daily, consistent work. Around 30 reels a month would be the goal.

- Raises as your work speaks for itself. When the page grows, you grow with it.

- Real training. You'll get my full style guide and direct feedback from me. You'll leave this a much better editor than you came in.

- Room to grow. There's a long-form YouTube channel and a startup behind this too. As it all takes off, there's a lot more to make, and you get first look.

- A real voice. I want your ideas on hooks, trends, and what to try next. You're a creative partner, not just a pair of hands.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word "Sunrise" so I know you read the whole thing. Then send me:



1. 3–5 Reels or TikToks you edited, and exactly what you did on each.

2. Which editing app you use, and whether you've used Instagram Edits.

3. One reel from any of the accounts above and two sentences on why it works.

4. Your rate per reel and how many reels a week you can realistically handle.



The strongest applicants get a paid test edit, one real reel from real footage, before we commit. So you get paid either way.



I need to see your work to consider you, so please don't skip the links. Excited to see what you've made and hopefully build this together!



— Giovanni

Preferred

title: AI Animation & Story Video Creator

* Strong visual judgment

* Experience with AI image or video generation

* Ability to keep characters consistent across scenes

* Ability to follow scripts and creative direction closely

* Comfortable generating multiple versions until a scene looks right

* Basic video editing skills

* Creative problem-solving ability



We are specifically looking for someone interested in **AI filmmaking, animation, storytelling, and character-based content**, not someone whose experience is primarily AI UGC avatars or talking-head advertisements.

Please send:



* A short introduction

title: CLEANING SERVICE REMOTE RECEPTIONIST & OPERATIONS ADMINISTRATOR (MALE PREFERRED)
description:
# REMOTE RECEPTIONIST & OPERATIONS ADMINISTRATOR



**Company:** thenycmaid  

**Location:** Remote  

**Starting Pay:** $250 USD/week  

**Pay:** Weekly or daily automatic payments available  

**Hours:** 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM New York/Eastern Time  

**Openings:** 2  

**Start:** Immediately / Ready to start Monday



## 🚨 INTRODUCTION VIDEO REQUIRED



**DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT AN INTRODUCTION VIDEO.**



Applications without the requested video will not be reviewed.



---



# ABOUT THENYCMAID



thenycmaid is an established and growing cleaning service serving New York City.



This is not a startup trying to figure out how to find customers.



Our business currently:



- Generates approximately **5–10 new organic leads every day**

- Operates a network of **100+ websites**

- Generates business organically without relying on paid advertising

- Has earned **100+ Google reviews**

- Works with approximately **10 cleaners**, with plans to significantly expand our cleaner roster

- Recently completed **200+ cleaning services in a single month for the first time**

- Historically closes approximately **80% of qualified leads**



Our operation is heavily automated through **Full Loop CRM**, and we're looking for people who can oversee that system, provide excellent customer service, solve problems, and help us continue growing.



**Previous cleaning-service industry experience is required.**



# THE POSITIONS



We are hiring **two people**.



### Weekday Position



**Monday – Friday**  

8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time



### Weekend Position



**Saturday – Sunday**  

8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time



Please clearly indicate which schedule you are applying for.



# WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS



This isn't a traditional receptionist position where you simply answer a telephone.



You will essentially be the **human operator overseeing an automated cleaning-service system**.



Our technology handles much of the repetitive work automatically.



Your responsibility is to **monitor the operation, communicate with customers and cleaners, and step in when human attention is required.**



# HOW OUR AUTOMATED SYSTEM WORKS



Our normal workflow looks like this:



**1. A lead comes in organically.**



We currently receive approximately 5–10 new leads per day.



**2. The system processes the lead.**



Bookings and jobs move through Full Loop CRM.



**3. Jobs are automatically assigned to cleaners.**



Our cleaners have their own portals where they manage their assigned work.



**4. Cleaners receive notifications about upcoming jobs.**



They receive a 30-minute notice before their scheduled service.



**5. Cleaners check in and check out through their portals.**



**6. Customer payments are collected automatically.**



**7. Cleaner payments are processed automatically.**



**8. Review requests and customer follow-ups are automated.**



When automation isn't enough, **you step in.**



Your job is to keep an eye on the entire operation and make sure things are running correctly.



# YOUR COMMAND CENTER: COMHUB



Most of your working day will be spent inside **ComHub**.



ComHub brings all of our incoming communications into one place:



- Phone calls

-
s

- Text messages

- Website chats



You will stay logged into ComHub throughout your shift and actively monitor incoming communications.



## 60-SECOND RESPONSE STANDARD



Our goal is simple:



**Incoming communications should be acknowledged or responded to within 60 seconds whenever reasonably possible.**



You're not expected to completely solve every problem in 60 seconds.



You **are** expected to acknowledge the customer or cleaner quickly and begin handling the situation.



This is not a position where you check messages every 15 minutes.



Monitoring communications **is the job**.



# YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



You will be responsible for:



- Answering incoming customer calls

- Responding to texts

- Responding to
s

- Responding to website chats

- Following up with new leads

- Scheduling cleaning services

- Reviewing bookings

- Approving bookings when necessary

- Monitoring automatic job assignments

- Communicating with cleaners

- Handling scheduling changes

- Handling cancellations

- Resolving routine customer concerns

- Resolving routine cleaner issues

- Updating customer and job information

- Monitoring cleaner check-ins and check-outs

- Following up after services

- Helping satisfied customers leave Google reviews

- Helping convert one-time customers into recurring customers

- Identifying problems in the automated workflow

- Taking action when automation requires human assistance

- Helping recruit additional cleaners

- Helping grow and improve the company



# WE WANT PROBLEM SOLVERS



This requirement is extremely important.



**We do not want someone who runs to the boss every time something goes wrong.**



Of course, management is available when something genuinely requires escalation.



But if every minor scheduling issue, customer question, or cleaner problem results in:



**“Boss, what should I do?”**



this will not be a good fit.



We want someone who can:



**Identify the problem → Gather the information → Think → Make a reasonable decision → Solve it.**



As you learn the business, you should become increasingly independent.



We value people whose first thought is:



**“How can I solve this?”**



not:



**“Who can I give this problem to?”**



# CUSTOMER SERVICE IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



Fast responses alone aren't enough.



We want customers to feel that they're dealing with a professional company that actually cares about their experience.



That means:



- Being friendly

- Communicating clearly

- Taking ownership

- Solving problems

- Following up

- Keeping customers informed

- Turning unhappy customers into satisfied customers

- Asking satisfied customers for reviews



We don't just want a customer to book once.



Our ideal customer journey is:



**LEAD → BOOKING → GREAT SERVICE → RECURRING CUSTOMER → GREAT REVIEW → REFERRAL**



Your job directly influences that process.



# PERFORMANCE & KPIs



We believe employees should know exactly what success looks like.



You'll have **individual performance standards** as well as **company growth targets**.



## KPI #1 — RESPONSE TIME



**Target: 60 seconds**



Incoming calls, texts,
s, and chats should be acknowledged or responded to within approximately **60 seconds whenever reasonably possible during your active shift**.



## KPI #2 — LEAD CLOSE RATE



**Target: 80%+ of qualified leads**



thenycmaid historically averages approximately an **80% close rate**.



We want to maintain or exceed that.



This doesn't mean aggressively selling people.



It means:



- Answering quickly

- Understanding what the customer needs

- Knowing our services

- Answering questions confidently

- Handling reasonable objections

- Following up

- Making booking easy



When someone contacts us looking for a cleaning service that we can provide, our goal is to turn that opportunity into a booking.



Spam, duplicate inquiries, services we don't provide, out-of-service-area inquiries, and other clearly unqualified contacts do not count as qualified leads.



## KPI #3 — MONTHLY COMPLETED SERVICES



We recently exceeded:



**200 SERVICES/MONTH**



for the first time.



Our current target is:



**225+ SERVICES/MONTH**



Then we'll continue raising the target as the company grows.



This is a company-wide goal rather than something one employee controls alone.



## KPI #4 — RECURRING CUSTOMER RATE



Current:



**~32%**



Target:



**40%+**



We want more customers choosing recurring cleaning services.



When appropriate, you should help customers understand their recurring-service options and follow up with satisfied customers about booking again.



## KPI #5 — AVERAGE TICKET



Previous average:



**~$228**



Recent average:



**~$210**



Target:



**$225+**



Part of the recent decline came from offering customers a $20 review incentive.



We're moving that incentive toward **$10** while continuing to grow our reviews and customer satisfaction.



## KPI #6 — REVIEWS & REPUTATION



We already have **100+ Google reviews**.



We want that number to keep growing.



Satisfied customers should be encouraged to share their experience.



We care about both:



**Quantity of reviews AND quality of customer experience.**



## KPI #7 — ATTENDANCE & RELIABILITY



Attendance is critical.



This isn't work that can simply wait until tomorrow.



Customers and cleaners are communicating with us in real time.



You must:



- Log in on time

- Be ready to work at the beginning of your shift

- Remain available throughout your shift

- Monitor ComHub consistently

- Communicate immediately if a genuine emergency occurs



Repeated lateness, disappearing during shifts, or regularly missing communications will not work in this position.



## KPI #8 — INDEPENDENT PROBLEM SOLVING



We will also evaluate how effectively you solve normal operational issues **without unnecessarily escalating everything to management**.



As you gain experience, we expect you to become increasingly capable of running day-to-day operations independently.



# BONUSES



We believe people who help grow the company should have opportunities to participate financially in that success.



There will be opportunities for **performance bonuses in addition to base compensation**.



Bonus opportunities may be tied to:



- Maintaining or exceeding an 80% close rate

- Exceeding monthly service targets

- Increasing recurring-service percentage

- Generating positive reviews

- Increasing customer retention

- Improving average ticket

- Recruiting quality cleaners

- Reducing missed opportunities

- Improving operational efficiency

- Creating successful new processes

- Identifying additional revenue opportunities



Our bonus structure will continue evolving as the company grows.



# BRING US IDEAS



We don't want someone who simply follows instructions forever.



We want someone who learns the business and eventually starts noticing things we don't.



If you see something that could improve:



- Customer experience

- Conversion

- Scheduling

- Recurring bookings

- Reviews

- Cleaner recruiting

- Cleaner retention

- Pricing

- Average ticket

- Communication

- Efficiency

- Revenue



**Tell us.**



We're open to listening.

And when someone's ideas produce measurable results for the company, we're open to rewarding that contribution.



# CLEANER RECRUITING & GROWTH



We currently work with approximately **10 cleaners**, and we're looking to expand.

title: APEX Operations Engineer — Internal Systems & DevOps (Sheets/Apps Script, HubSpot, Git)
description:
Read this first: This is an ENTRY-level seat with a real ceiling — not a senior role. Most operations jobs are dead-end. This one isn't. You start running part of our internal systems, and as you prove yourself, you grow into owning the entire internal operating system across all our businesses — and taking DevOps work off our lead engineer. Scope, trust, and pay grow with performance. Our lead engineer walked this exact path here. If you want a finished senior title handed to you on day one, this isn't it. If you want to EARN one, keep reading.



ABOUT THE WORK

We run our business on internal operating systems — the same repeatable pattern (data masters, dashboards, review queues, health checks, logs, automations) running across several ventures. The core is built in Google Sheets + Apps Script, and it connects out to the tools we run the business on: HubSpot (CRM/pipeline), QuickMail (cold
), Quo (voice/SMS), Slack (team + alerts), and Stripe (payments). Our engineering lives in GitHub. It all works and it's good — but it was built piece by piece, it's not standardized, and it's not in version control (Git/clasp). Right now the founder is the only person who fully knows how it all runs. Your job is to change that.



Important boundary: This is our INTERNAL operations layer. It is NOT the customer-facing product — that's engineering's world. You won't write product features. You WILL own how the internal machine runs, connects, and ships.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Standardize our systems: take the best version of each pattern (queues, logs, health checks, automations) and make everything match it. Solve it once, not five times.

- Own the connections between tools: data flows out to HubSpot / QuickMail / Quo, and signals (opens, replies, deal outcomes, payments) flow back to our systems, all keyed to one identity. Keep those adapters clean and swappable.

- Get our Apps Script into clasp + Git and own the versioning/release (DevOps) process.

- Run the daily rhythm: work the review queues, watch the health-check alerts, keep everything clean and current so the founder is out of daily operation.

- Read across systems to catch duplication and broken handoffs before they cause problems. You're the person who notices "wait, we already built this."



WHO YOU ARE (this matters more than your résumé)

- You SURFACE PROBLEMS. You hit something broken, confusing, or duplicated and you raise it — WITH a recommendation, not just a complaint. You can't walk past a mess. This is the #1 trait we're hiring for.

- You're CURIOUS FIRST, then honest. You understand WHY something exists before proposing to change it, then you say the true thing directly.

- You're PROACTIVE. You fill your own queue. Nobody should have to tell you what to work on.

- You TEACH YOURSELF. If you don't know a tool yet but you'll have it down in two weeks, that counts.



WHAT YOU NEED TO START

- Advanced Google Sheets.

- Can read and write Apps Script (JavaScript) — enough to fix a function, edit a config, set up a trigger, connect an API, and run a change carefully.

- Comfortable working with tools like HubSpot and connecting APIs between systems.

- Familiar with Git, OR a fast learner who will pick up Git + clasp quickly.

- The character above — especially the instinct to catch problems and bring a fix.



BONUS (not required — these move you toward the senior end of the pay range faster)

- MySQL / SQL databases.

- Laravel / PHP.

- Experience connecting or automating between SaaS tools (HubSpot, Stripe,
/SMS APIs, Zapier/Make/n8n, etc.).

- Any DevOps / CI / deployment experience.

We're heading toward an owned platform (MySQL + Laravel) over time — if you can grow into that, this seat grows a lot.



HOW TO APPLY

Reply with:

1. The word "APEX" at the top of your application (so I know you read this).

2. A short description of an internal system, tool, or automation you built — in Google Sheets/Apps Script, or connecting tools like HubSpot/Stripe/APIs — what problem it solved and how you built it.

3. One time you noticed something was broken or being done inefficiently, and what you did about it.



Applications without these three things won't be reviewed. There is a short test as part of hiring.

title: Automation / Data Engineer (Part-Time) — Build a Lead Enrichment Engine
description:
We run a B2B lead generation pipeline built on public business filing data. Records come in on an automated pull, get scored and tiered, and route to our sales team through  CRM.



The problem: contact enrichment is still manual. Two people research each record by hand to find phone numbers and
s, and they can't keep pace with volume. Our highest-value records go stale before anyone touches them.



Your job is to make that step disappear.



This is a build project first, with ongoing part-time work maintaining and extending the system afterward if it goes well.



What you'll build



Automated enrichment. Integrate third-party data APIs to resolve contact information without human involvement. Includes deduplication and caching so we never pay twice for the same lookup, phone line type validation, and fallback logic when a lookup fails.



Automated lead scoring. Our raw data contains signals we aren't currently computing. You'll derive them at ingest and build them into a scoring model that runs on every record automatically. I need to be able to adjust scoring weights myself without asking you for a code change.



Prioritized review queue. Records that fail automated lookup go to a human queue, ordered by record value and freshness rather than first in first out.



Monitoring and alerting. This matters as much as the build. The system runs unattended against paid APIs and feeds a queue our sales team depends on. I need failure alerts, spend anomaly alerts, rate limit handling with backoff, and retry logic that doesn't duplicate paid lookups. A silent failure costs real money.



Documentation. A deliverable, not an afterthought. System documentation, a runbook for common failures, and a walkthrough where I can demonstrate I understand how to operate it. I built the current pipeline myself and I'm not willing to end up unable to troubleshoot my own system.



Required

Strong Python, or n8n plus Python

Real experience integrating third-party APIs, including handling rate limits, pagination, retries, and auth

Experience working with large volumes of messy record data: deduplication, normalization, fuzzy matching on names and addresses

A database background (PostgreSQL or similar)

You've built something that ran unattended in production and you know what it takes to keep it running

Clear English



Nice to have

Google Apps Script and Google Sheets API

Close CRM or comparable CRM APIs

Experience with skip trace, identity, or B2B contact enrichment vendors

Dashboarding (Looker Studio, Metabase, or similar)

Any background in lending, MCA, fintech.
