title: TikTok Shop Manager — CPG Food Brand (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
About the Company

We're a growing CPG (consumer packaged goods) food brand selling a specialty baking/dessert ingredient. Our product is sold direct-to-consumer online and in national retail stores, and we're now growing our presence on TikTok Shop. Our brand voice is fun, playful, bold, and trendy. We care about authenticity, in our product and in how we show up online — nothing customer-facing that comes out of this role should be AI-generated. Full company name and brand details will be shared directly with the candidate we move forward with.



A growing CPG food brand is looking for a TikTok Shop Manager to build and run our TikTok Shop storefront from the ground up. You'll own everything that turns our existing TikTok following into TikTok Shop sales — this is a high-impact role for someone who understands both the TikTok Shop platform and how to sell a food/CPG product.



One thing to know before you apply: we don't let AI write anything that reaches our customers or affiliates directly. See "How we use AI" below.



What you'll do:

- Set up and continuously optimize our TikTok Shop product catalog — titles, descriptions, images, pricing, and categories for each product variant

- Recruit, onboard, and manage affiliate creators through TikTok's Creator Marketplace/affiliate program to promote our products in exchange for commission, growing our reach beyond our own account

- Plan and coordinate livestream shopping events (LIVE selling), including scheduling hosts, prepping talking points, and promoting the stream in advance

- Set up and manage TikTok Shop ads (Shop Ads / GMV Max) and promotional tools — vouchers, flash sales, bundle deals — to drive conversions

- Monitor TikTok Shop analytics (views, click-through, conversion rate, GMV) and report weekly on what's working, with recommendations to improve

- Keep inventory, pricing, and order fulfillment in sync between TikTok Shop and our online store

- Handle TikTok Shop customer questions, reviews, and any order issues, in your own words

- Stay current on TikTok Shop policy, algorithm, and feature changes and flag anything that affects our strategy

- Work with our content creator to make sure videos link to the right products and use TikTok Shop's shoppable video/showcase features



Why this role matters:

TikTok Shop turns our existing audience (already posting 3–5 videos per day) directly into a sales channel instead of just brand awareness. A dedicated manager means affiliate creators start promoting us at scale, live selling events convert real-time interest into purchases, and our catalog and ads are actually optimized instead of left on autopilot — all of which should meaningfully grow TikTok-driven revenue.



How we use AI:

We're happy to use AI-powered tools for things like ad optimization, analytics, and workflow efficiency — that's a normal part of running a lean shop. But nothing that reaches a real customer or affiliate directly (messages, responses, reviews) should be written by AI and passed off as us. Real, human communication is part of how we keep customer trust.



What we're looking for:

- Proven experience managing a TikTok Shop for a brand — you must provide examples of previous work (e.g., shops you've set up/managed, GMV or affiliate-growth results)

- Familiarity with TikTok's Seller Center, Creator Marketplace, and TikTok Shop ads

- Comfortable with basic e-commerce operations (inventory, order sync, fulfillment coordination)

- Data-comfortable — able to read shop analytics and turn them into a clear action plan

- Strong written English for creator outreach and customer service, in your own voice

- Self-directed; comfortable owning a channel with minimal day-to-day oversight



Nice to have:

- Experience in food, beverage, or CPG brands

- Experience hosting or producing livestream shopping events

- Familiarity with Shopify



Schedule & pay:

Part-time, remote, ongoing — starting at approximately 5 hours/week at $5.00 /hour, with hours and rate potentially increasing depending on your experience and the results you deliver.



To apply:

Please include 2–3 examples of TikTok Shops you've managed and any GMV or affiliate-growth results you can share. Applications without examples of previous work will not be considered.

title: AI TWIN
description:
AI TWIN + GO HIGH LEVEL AUTOMATION SPECIALIST



Full-Time / Long-Term Opportunity



We are looking for an experienced AI Automation Specialist / AI Twin Developer** to build an AI version of our founder that can communicate with leads, qualify prospects, follow up, overcome objections, and help generate booked appointments.



This is NOT a basic chatbot position.



We are building a **revenue-generating AI sales and communication system** that should eventually handle conversations at a level that feels extremely close to communicating directly with the founder.



## THE GOAL



Your job is to help us build an AI Twin that can:



* Speak and respond like the founder

* Understand the founder's personality, tone, mindset, and business philosophy

* Handle incoming leads

* Ask intelligent qualifying questions

* Answer FAQs

* Handle common objections

* Follow up with prospects

* Guide qualified prospects toward booking a call

* Update information inside our CRM

* Trigger automations based on conversations

* Scale the founder's ability to communicate without requiring him to personally answer every message



The AI should sound **confident, direct, conversational, natural, and human — NOT robotic.**



## MUST-HAVE SKILLS



**DO NOT APPLY unless you have real experience with most of the following:**



* ChatGPT / OpenAI

* OpenAI API

* Advanced prompt engineering

* AI agents / AI assistants

* Chatbot development

* AI automation

* GoHighLevel

* CRM workflows

* API integrations

* Webhooks

* Lead qualification systems

* Automated follow-up systems



Experience with the following is a strong plus:



* Claude

* Gemini

* 

* Zapier

* n8n

* Voice AI

* Eleven Labs

* Vapi

* Retell AI

* AI appointment setters



You must also have strong English communication skills.



Your written English must sound **natural and conversational**, not like AI-generated customer service language.



# CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



## 1. BUILD THE AI TWIN



This is your primary responsibility.



You will study real material from the founder, including:



* Voice notes

* Text messages

*
s

* Sales conversations

* Call transcripts

* Videos

* Social media content

* FAQs

* Objection-handling conversations

* Business philosophies

* Sales frameworks

* Previous customer conversations



You will identify patterns in how the founder communicates and create a structured AI knowledge system around them.



The AI should learn:



* Vocabulary

* Tone

* Personality

* Humor

* Sentence structure

* Sales style

* Questions the founder asks

* How the founder handles objections

* How the founder motivates prospects

* How the founder closes conversations

* When to push

* When to follow up

* When to qualify someone out

* When to send someone to a human



The goal is NOT simply to give ChatGPT information.



The goal is to create an actual **Founder Communication System.**



## 2. BUILD THE AI KNOWLEDGE BASE



Organize our company knowledge into a system the AI can properly use.



This may include:



* Company information

* Services

* Pricing

* FAQs

* Offers

* Sales scripts

* Objection responses

* Client qualification rules

* Founder philosophy

* Standard operating procedures

* Testimonials

* Case studies

* Lead conversations

* Booking instructions



You must understand how to structure information so the AI retrieves the **correct information at the correct time.**



## 3. GOHIGHLEVEL + CRM INTEGRATION



You will connect the AI Twin with **GoHighLevel** and build automated workflows.



Example:



**New Lead → AI Conversation → Qualification → Follow-Up → Appointment Booking → CRM Update → Human Notification**



You may also build:



*
/Instagram Lead → CRM → AI Response → Qualification → Calendar Booking**



**Website Lead → AI Conversation → Follow-Up → Booking**



**No Response → Automated AI Follow-Up Sequence**



**Missed Appointment → AI Re-Engagement**



**Old Lead → AI Reactivation Campaign**



We want the system working across as many appropriate communication channels as possible.



## 4. AI SALES & LEAD QUALIFICATION



The AI must understand the difference between having a conversation and moving a prospect toward a business outcome.



It should be able to:



* Identify what the prospect needs

* Ask qualifying questions

* Determine whether the prospect is a good fit

* Answer questions

* Handle objections

* Build trust

* Keep conversations moving

* Follow up appropriately

* Book qualified appointments



We will measure this system based on **RESULTS**, not simply how many automations were created.



Important KPIs may include:



* Leads contacted

* Response rate

* Qualified leads

* Appointments booked

* Show rate

* Conversion rate

* Follow-up recovery

* Revenue influenced by AI



# WHO WE WANT



We want somebody who thinks like a **builder and problem solver.**



Do not apply if your main skill is copying prompts from ChatGPT.



We want someone who can look at a business problem and say:



**"Here is how I would build the AI system to solve it."**



You should be comfortable researching solutions independently, testing different approaches, troubleshooting integrations, documenting your work, and continuously improving the system based on real conversations.



# HOW TO APPLY



Your application MUST include all of the following:



### 1. RESUME + PORTFOLIO



Show us AI systems, automations, chatbots, CRM workflows, or similar projects you have actually built.



### 2. VOICE NOTE



Send a **1–2 minute voice recording** introducing yourself.



Tell us:



* Who you are

* Your AI experience

* Your GoHighLevel experience

* Why you believe you can build this system



### 3. RESULTS



Do not only tell us your responsibilities.



Tell us what you produced.



Examples:



* "Built an AI assistant that handled 500+ conversations."

* "Created an automation that increased bookings by 30%."

* "Built an AI appointment setter."

* "Reduced manual follow-up by 70%."

* "Integrated OpenAI with GoHighLevel."



Provide numbers whenever possible.



### 4. TEST TASK



Explain how you would build this system:



**Lead enters GoHighLevel → AI immediately starts conversation → AI qualifies lead → handles basic objections → follows up automatically → qualified prospect books appointment → CRM opportunity is updated → sales team is notified.**



Send us:



* The tools you would use

* How the system would work

* What information you would need from the founder

* How you would train the AI

* How you would prevent incorrect or robotic responses

* How you would continuously improve the AI



You do NOT need to build the entire system for the application.



We want to see **how you think.**



# IMPORTANT



We are not looking for someone who simply completes assigned tasks.



We are looking for someone who can help us build an AI infrastructure that becomes a serious asset to the company.



The long-term vision is simple:



**The founder should be able to train the system once, and the AI should help communicate, qualify, follow up, and generate appointments 24/7.**



If you cannot build something approaching **human-level business conversations**, this is probably not the right role.



If you understand AI, automation, sales psychology, CRM systems, and how to turn conversations into appointments, we want to hear from you.



**When applying, put "AI TWIN BUILDER" at the beginning of your application so we know you read the entire job post.**

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE

PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT

OR A SALE.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE

PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT

OR A SALE.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.

All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)

- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Total: ~$1,250/month

- Base: $950

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month

This is a remote role for a strong full stack developer with backend Java microservices experience and modern Angular frontend experience. You will work on secure, scalable applications that support high-volume financial workflows.



## Responsibilities



- Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable full stack applications

- Build backend services using Java microservices architecture

- Support service communication using gRPC and API integrations

- Develop responsive frontend applications using Angular 16+ and TypeScript

- Integrate frontend and backend services through GraphQL APIs

- Work with AWS services for hosting, scalability, monitoring, and performance

- Work with NoSQL data stores, especially DynamoDB

- Build reusable UI components and contribute to frontend standards

- Implement dynamic forms, real-time data updates, RxJS, and modern state management patterns

- Participate in code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD workflows, debugging, and technical planning

- Help maintain secure, reliable software for enterprise financial use cases



## Required Skills



- Strong full stack software development experience

- Java backend development experience

- Microservices architecture experience

- Angular 16+ and TypeScript experience

- Experience with GraphQL or similar API integrations

- AWS cloud experience

- NoSQL database experience, preferably DynamoDB

- Git-based workflows, CI/CD, and automated testing experience

- Strong debugging, system design, and problem-solving skills

- Good written and spoken English communication



## Nice to Have



- Experience with financial services, banking, lending, mortgage, or SaaS platforms

- Experience with gRPC

- Enterprise security or compliance experience

- Strong UX/product collaboration experience



## Work Setup



- Remote, Philippines-based candidates preferred

- Full-time role, 40 hours per week

- Compensation: $12-$17/hour depending on experience



To apply, please send:



1. Your resume or portfolio

2. Links to relevant projects, GitHub, or applications you have worked on

3. A short summary of your Java, Angular, AWS, GraphQL, and DynamoDB experience

4. Your current availability and expected hourly rate

5. Confirmation that you are Filipino and currently based in the Philippines



We are looking for someone who can communicate clearly, write maintainable code, and work well with a US-based software team.



Please apply only with your own accurate experience and work samples. Interviews and technical assessments must be completed by you directly, without another person taking the interview or assessment on your behalf.

title: Virtual Assistant (Remote)
description:
Kolbe 15 is a founder community built around real, in-person connection, peer groups, curated experiences, retreats, and public events for ambitious founders and operators. We're looking for a Virtual Assistant who can own both the research and the execution side of running it, so the founder can stay focused on members, partnerships, and content instead of logistics.



The Role



This isn't a "do exactly what I say" assistant role. If we're planning a trip to Mexico and you're told "we need A, B, C," you research the options, find the most suitable price, negotiate with vendors, and bring back a decision-ready recommendation, not just a list of links. That's the standard for everything below.



What You'll Do



- Trip & event planning — research venues, activities, and vendors for retreats and events (e.g. the Tulum trip); find the best options, negotiate pricing, and manage bookings

- Grants — search for relevant grants, determine eligibility, and apply on Kolbe's behalf

- Sponsorship & partnerships — find and reach out to potential sponsors and resources, track the pipeline, and keep relationships moving

- Calendar management — keep the founder's calendar accurate and up to date; schedule meetings and events

- Event coordination & member communication — manage logistics for recurring activities (Tuesday Runs, cohort weekends, panel series) and communicate directly with members and attendees

- Speaker/panelist coordination — outreach, prep materials, and logistics for event speakers and panelists

- Outreach tracking — keep the outreach log and member/founder directory current so nothing falls through

- Inbox triage— flag what needs a personal reply vs. what you can handle directly

- Light expense/invoice tracking

- Represent Kolbe 15 professionally — including keeping a polished, professional LinkedIn presence for outward-facing communication



What We're Looking For



- Strong research instincts — you dig past the first search result and bring back a real recommendation, not just raw options

- Comfortable negotiating with vendors and external parties on Kolbe's behalf

- Takes initiative rather than waiting for every step to be spelled out

- Highly organized — can juggle multiple live projects (a trip, a grant application, a sponsor pipeline) at once

- Excellent written communication — comfortable reaching out to new people and representing the community well

- Professional, presentable LinkedIn profile

- Comfortable with Google Workspace, Luma, and picking up new tools as needed

- Trustworthy with sensitive information (applicant data, member details, finances)



How to Apply



Along with your resume/LinkedIn, complete the following exercise. This isn't about a "correct" answer — it's about how you think when you don't have much to go on, since that's exactly day one of this role.



**All you're given to start:** the founder's name is Behzad Hariri, based in Toronto, Canada. That's it.



1. Research who he is and what he does, using whatever's publicly available.

2. Based on what you find, plan out a full day for him — that would actually be useful and interesting to *him specifically*, not a generic "productive day" template.

3. Write up your reasoning: what you found, what you inferred, what assumptions you made, and what you'd ask him directly if you could.



Excited to see what you come up with

title: Part-Time Business Operations & Sales Support Assistant
description:
Five Star Bath Solutions of Sioux Falls is a growing bathroom remodeling company serving homeowners throughout South Dakota, Iowa, and Minnesota. We help homeowners transform their bathrooms with new showers, tubs, wall systems, fixtures, and other bathroom remodeling solutions.



We are a small but growing company and are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented person to help us improve our reporting, administrative processes, sales support, and marketing follow-up.



About the Position



We are looking for a part-time Business Operations & Sales Support Assistant to work remotely with our team.



A major part of this position will involve working with spreadsheets, reviewing information for accuracy, preparing reports, and making sure recurring administrative tasks are completed on time.



We are looking for someone who doesn't simply enter data, but who pays attention to the information and asks questions when something doesn't look right.



This position will initially be approximately 15 hours per week, with the opportunity for additional hours, compensation, and responsibilities as the role develops.



Primary Responsibilities

Prepare and distribute daily and weekly KPI reports

Prepare weekly payroll worksheets for owner review

Review installation worksheets and other company reports for completeness and accuracy

Create and maintain Excel and Google Sheets spreadsheets

Organize sales, lead, installation, and financial data into useful management summaries

Prepare lead-source performance reports, including leads, appointments, sales, conversion rates, and costs

Assist with job-costing reports and identify missing or inconsistent information

Reconcile information between reports and systems and investigate discrepancies

Review and pre-screen job applicants

Organize candidate information and recommend qualified candidates for interviews

Update CRM and customer information as needed

Follow up with team members or vendors when information or reports are missing

Help document and organize company procedures

Additional Responsibilities



As the role develops, responsibilities may also include:



Posting before-and-after project photos to Yelp, Thumbtack, and other online platforms

Assisting with light social media posting

Tracking online reviews and other marketing activity

Assisting with lead and appointment reporting

Following up on aged leads or unsold estimates

Helping track events and marketing results

Assisting with other administrative projects as the company grows



There may eventually be an opportunity to contact leads, confirm customer information, follow up with prospective customers, and schedule appointments. Candidates with strong, easily understood spoken English may be given additional phone responsibilities after training.



What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate:



Has excellent written English

Clear, professional spoken English

Is highly proficient with Excel and/or Google Sheets

Is comfortable working with numbers and business data

Has exceptional attention to detail

Notices when information appears incorrect or incomplete rather than simply copying data

Is organized and dependable with recurring deadlines

Can work independently after being trained

Communicates proactively when something is unclear

Is comfortable learning new software and systems

Can manage several recurring responsibilities without needing constant reminders

Handles confidential business and employee information professionally

Quiet, professional workspace suitable for video meetings and potential customer phone calls

Reliable, high-speed internet connection and a dependable computer suitable for remote work



Previous experience supporting a U.S.-based business is strongly preferred. Experience with CRM systems, payroll preparation, lead tracking, recruiting, home-service businesses, social media, or business reporting is also helpful.



To Apply



Please answer the following questions:



1) Tell me about your experience working with a U.S.-based company. What were your primary responsibilities?

2) Describe your experience with Excel or Google Sheets. Give one specific example of a report, spreadsheet, dashboard, or analysis you created.

3) Imagine you are preparing our weekly KPI report and notice that the sales total in our CRM does not match the sales total on the salesperson's report. What steps would you take before sending the report?

4) Please provide a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be a good fit for this position.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of our team. Candidates who perform well may have opportunities for increased hours, compensation, and responsibility.

title: China sourcing and procurement specialist
description:
China Sourcing & Procurement Specialist



Products: SPC/LVP Flooring & RTA Kitchen Cabinets



We are a U.S.-based construction and remodeling company looking for an experienced China Sourcing & Procurement Specialist to help us source building materials directly from manufacturers in China.



This is NOT a general virtual assistant position.



We are specifically looking for someone who has experience sourcing products from Chinese manufacturers using 1688, Alibaba, direct factory contacts, and other Chinese sourcing channels.



Our initial focus is:



1. SPC/LVP Flooring

2. RTA Kitchen Cabinets



If the relationship is successful, additional construction products may be added later.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



You will be responsible for researching, locating, verifying, negotiating with, and comparing Chinese manufacturers.



We do NOT simply want the cheapest supplier.



We want the best combination of price, quality, reliability, certifications, shipping cost, and manufacturer credibility.



You will:



• Locate actual manufacturers/factories rather than unnecessary middlemen or trading companies.



• Search Alibaba, 1688, Chinese manufacturer directories, and other appropriate sourcing channels.



• Communicate directly with factories.



• Determine whether each supplier is a manufacturer, trading company, or sourcing agent.



• Obtain and negotiate factory pricing.



• Negotiate MOQ requirements.



• Request samples.



• Obtain product specifications and technical documentation.



• Obtain available U.S.-market certifications and testing reports.



• Compare several manufacturers rather than recommending the first supplier you find.



• Investigate the supplier's history, factory capabilities, production capacity, export experience, and reputation.



• Determine production lead times.



• Obtain packaging specifications, carton/pallet dimensions and weights.



• Determine how much product fits into 20-foot and 40-foot containers when applicable.



• Obtain FOB and other relevant shipping quotations.



• Help coordinate freight-forwarding quotations to New Jersey, USA.



• Help calculate the approximate landed cost in New Jersey, not simply the factory purchase price.



• Assist with quality-control inspections before final payment/shipment.



• Maintain organized records of suppliers, quotations, samples, specifications and communications.



FLOORING SOURCING



We are particularly interested in quality SPC/LVP waterproof flooring suitable for residential and light-commercial construction.



You should be able to compare manufacturers based on items including:



• SPC construction

• Overall plank thickness

• Wear-layer thickness

• Attached underlayment/padding

• Click-lock system

• Residential/commercial warranty

• Scratch and wear resistance

• Waterproof performance

• Available colors/designs

• Packaging

• Square footage per carton

• Pallet quantities

• Container quantities

• Certifications/testing

• MOQ

• Factory price per square meter/square foot

• FOB price

• Production time

• Sample availability



We will determine final specifications after reviewing factory options.



CABINET SOURCING



We are primarily interested in RTA (Ready-to-Assemble) kitchen cabinets because shipping efficiency is important.



We want manufacturers capable of producing cabinet lines appropriate for the U.S. remodeling market.



You should compare:



• Cabinet-box construction

• Plywood vs. particleboard/MDF components

• Box thickness

• Door construction

• Painted and stained finishes

• Shaker-style availability

• Soft-close hinges

• Soft-close drawer slides

• Drawer-box construction

• Hardware quality

• Standard U.S. cabinet dimensions

• Available cabinet sizes/SKUs

• Matching panels, fillers, moldings and accessories

• Packaging quality

• Replacement-part policy

• Warranty

• MOQ

• Sample/demo cabinet availability

• Container capacity

• Factory pricing

• FOB pricing

• Production lead time



WHAT WE DO NOT WANT



We do not want someone who simply searches Alibaba, copies several links and sends them to us.



We can do that ourselves.



Your value is in finding the factory behind the product, communicating with the manufacturer, negotiating, verifying information, identifying problems, and determining the true cost of getting the product to us in the United States.



We expect you to question suppliers and verify claims rather than simply accepting what a salesperson tells you.



EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Strong candidates should have experience with several of the following:



• China product sourcing

• 1688 sourcing

• Alibaba sourcing

• Factory verification

• Supplier negotiation

• Procurement

• Import/export

• Quality control

• Freight forwarding

• Container shipping

• U.S. imports

• Building materials

• Flooring

• Kitchen cabinets



Mandarin/Chinese-language ability is a major advantage.



Experience specifically sourcing construction materials, SPC flooring, LVP flooring, cabinetry, furniture or building products is highly preferred.



PAID/TRIAL SOURCING ASSIGNMENT



Before selecting someone for ongoing work, qualified applicants may be given a sourcing assignment.



You may be asked to identify:



3 legitimate SPC/LVP flooring manufacturers



and



3 legitimate RTA kitchen-cabinet manufacturers.



For each manufacturer, we want a comparison showing:



1. Factory/company name

2. Factory location

3. Manufacturer vs. trading company

4. Years in business

5. Main products

6. Export experience to the United States

7. Product specifications

8. Certifications/testing documentation

9. MOQ

10. Sample cost

11. Unit/factory price

12. FOB price

13. Production lead time

14. Packaging information

15. Container capacity

16. Payment terms

17. Quality-control options

18. Freight estimate to New Jersey, if available

19. Approximate landed cost

20. Your assessment of the supplier and any concerns/red flags



Simply submitting Alibaba links will NOT qualify as completing the assignment.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with the words:



“FACTORY DIRECT”



This lets us know you read the entire posting.



Then answer these questions:



1. How many years have you worked in China sourcing/procurement?



2. Do you personally use 1688?



3. Can you communicate with suppliers in Mandarin/Chinese?



4. Have you sourced products for U.S. companies before?



5. Have you sourced flooring, cabinets, furniture, construction materials or similar products?



6. How do you determine whether a supplier is an actual manufacturer rather than a trading company?



7. How do you verify a Chinese factory before a buyer sends a substantial deposit?



8. What methods do you use to negotiate better pricing and MOQ?



9. Have you coordinated third-party factory inspections?



10. Have you worked with freight forwarders and container shipments to the United States?



11. Provide an example of a sourcing project you completed and explain how you reduced the buyer's cost or prevented a sourcing problem.



12. What is your hourly or project-based rate?



IMPORTANT



We are looking for a long-term sourcing relationship, but we will start small.



Our goal is to establish reliable direct relationships with manufacturers that can supply our construction company at pricing that makes financial sense after product cost + freight + duties/tariffs + customs/brokerage + inspections + inland transportation + all other import expenses.



We care about the number that matters:



THE FINAL LANDED COST IN NEW JERSEY.



If you are experienced in finding legitimate Chinese manufacturers, negotiating factory-direct pricing and protecting buyers from sourcing mistakes, we would like to hear from you.

title: AI Image Designer + Video Gen for Meta Ads
description:
AI STATIC & MOTION DESIGNER — HEALTH & WELLNESS APP SUITE



We're hiring an AI-savvy visual designer to produce high-volume, hyper-realistic ad creative for a growing suite of health and wellness food apps. If you can make AI-generated images and video that look like they came from a real photoshoot — not a render — this is for you.



ABOUT THE ROLE



You'll be the primary creative engine behind our Meta ad creative across multiple apps. This is a high-output role: you'll be expected to consistently produce a large volume of scroll-stopping, on-brand statics and short product/recipe videos using AI generation tools, while keeping quality tight and results measurable.



We move fast and we care about craft. We're looking for someone with real agency — who can take a rough brief, run with it, and come back with options that are already brand-ready, not someone who needs every detail specified.



This is a contract-to-hire role. You'll start part-time. If you're successful, this converts to a full-time position (40+ hours/week).



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Produce a high volume of AI-generated static ad creative (product shots, lifestyle imagery, food/recipe visuals) for Meta ads across our app suite

- Generate short AI video content, including satisfying recipe and product videos — ingredients coming together, product reveals, close-up food/product shots

- Use tools like Grok Imagine and Gemini Nano Banana (and stay current on new tools as they emerge) to produce imagery that reads as authentic photography/videography, not AI-generated

- Maintain visual and brand consistency across a fast-moving content calendar

- Iterate quickly based on ad performance data — what's working, what's not, and why

- Continuously push creative quality and volume without sacrificing either



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Proven ability to produce AI statics that look realistic — this is non-negotiable. Our audience notices and dislikes anything that reads as "AI slop"

- Hands-on experience with AI image/video tools like Grok Imagine and Gemini Nano Banana (and openness to picking up new tools as they emerge)

- Comfort producing high volume without quality drop-off

- Strong eye for food, product, and lifestyle photography aesthetics

- Self-direction — you should be able to take loose creative direction and run

- Bonus: experience with Meta Ads creative testing and understanding what visual patterns drive performance



COMPENSATION



This is an hourly + performance role.



- Base pay: $5–$10/hour, depending on experience level

- Performance bonuses: on top of base, for high-performing ads (based on Meta Ads metrics) and for high production volume



We want this to reward output and results, not just time logged — the bonus structure is where the real upside is for the right person.



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application — respond to this posting with answers to the questions below

2. Trial task — if selected based on your application, you'll be sent a paid/unpaid trial task

3. Interview — if you do well on the trial task, you'll interview directly with the founder

4. Hire — offer extended from there, starting part-time with a path to full-time



HOW TO APPLY



This posting will get a lot of applicants, so we're using the application itself as a first filter. Please answer the following in your application. Short, direct answers are fine — we care more about substance than polish here.



1. Why are you passionate about health and wellness?

2. How have you personally committed to health and wellness in your own life?

3. What accomplishments are you proud of — creative, professional, or personal?

4. How much experience do you have with graphic design and/or AI-generated design specifically?

5. What AI tools do you currently have access to (paid subscriptions, free tiers, etc.)?

6. What's your experience with each of the following: Grok Imagine, Gemini Nano Banana, and any other AI image/video tools you use? Be specific about what you've made with each.

7. Roughly how much output have you produced with these specific tools (volume, timeframe, context)?

8. What do you think is your single greatest strength for this role? Are you fastest at high-quality output? Most creative/out-of-the-box? Most consistent at hitting photorealism? Tell us what makes you the right fit, specifically.

9. Tell us about your current work setup: Do you have any clients you're currently working for? Do you have capacity to ramp to full-time if this goes well? Is your setup comfortable for working remotely? What's your Wi-Fi speed? Do you have a workspace you can use daily for a full-time workload?

10. Please link a portfolio or samples of past work (AI-generated or otherwise).



One more thing: to confirm you've read this entire posting, end your application with the word "homemade" as the very last word of your submission.

title: Real Estate Acquisitions Coordinator
description:

Brown & Company Properties is seeking an experienced, highly organized Real Estate Acquisitions Coordinator to assist with the controlled expansion of our rental portfolio in Alabama.



This is a part-time remote position starting at approximately 8 hours per week. We are focused on quality over quantity and are looking for someone interested in developing a long-term working relationship with our company.



Responsibilities include:



* Research rental opportunities in Huntsville and Birmingham, Alabama

Remote Work, Monitoring & Accountability

description:

We are a U.S.-based real estate investment company focused on identifying off-market opportunities, working directly with property owners, and acquiring and wholesaling residential investment properties.



This is NOT simply a data-entry position. We are looking for someone who understands real estate lead generation and can eventually become a key part of our acquisitions operation.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Cold call property owners using BatchDialer

• Work and organize lead lists using BatchLeads

• Ask about motivation, property condition, occupancy, timeline, asking price, and other relevant information

• Skip trace and verify owner contact information

• Identify absentee owners, vacant properties, inherited properties, distressed properties, tax-delinquent properties, and other potential opportunities

• Build and maintain cash-buyer and investor lists

• Research buyers through public records and previous investor purchases

• Assist with buyer outreach and disposition activities when deals are available

• Prepare concise lead summaries so our acquisitions decision-maker can quickly evaluate opportunities



CURRENT TOOLS



We currently use:



• BatchLeads

• BatchDialer

• LandGlide

ChatGPT

Experience with additional real estate CRMs, PropStream, REI software, comparable-sales research, skip tracing, title/property research, or wholesaling systems is a plus.



WHO WE WANT

You should:

• Be comfortable speaking with U.S. property owners by phone

HOW TO APPLY

title: Telecommunications / Electrical Design Engineer – AutoCAD & Technical Work Packages (Part-Time)
description:
Engineering Project Desk is seeking a part-time remote Telecommunications / Electrical Design Engineer who can independently investigate engineering problems, evaluate equipment upgrades, propose defensible solutions, and produce clear drawings and technical work packages for review.



HOURS AND COMPENSATION

Approximately 15–20 hours per week. Initial target rate: USD $6–$8/hour, based on demonstrated capability. Higher compensation may be considered after proven performance. Remote work with agreed deadlines and scheduled coordination.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Analyze existing conditions and integration requirements using sanitized drawings, technical notes, and public equipment manuals.

• Research and compare technical solutions; document calculations, assumptions, alternatives, risks, and recommendations.

• Develop AutoCAD drawings, wiring/interconnection diagrams, equipment layouts, revisions, and PDF deliverables.

• Support telecommunications, radio communications, IP networking, audio/control interfaces, and DC power integration.

• Prepare bills of materials and technical work packages covering scope, removal/installation, wiring, configuration requirements, testing, acceptance criteria, and contingency steps.

• Cite technical sources by document title, revision, and page/section; reconcile drawings, BOMs, and written instructions.

• Flag missing information as TBD / ENGINEER TO CONFIRM. Never invent pinouts, ratings, settings, or design requirements.

• Maintain organized Google Drive project files, revision records, time reports, and QA/QC responses.



REQUIRED CAPABILITIES

• Electrical, electronics, telecommunications, or closely related engineering education and relevant practical design experience.

• Independent technical problem-solving and systems integration experience.

• Strong AutoCAD capability and ability to read schematics, manuals, and specifications.

• Clear written English and well-organized engineering documentation.

• Ability to explain and defend your own calculations, design choices, and deliverables during live discussion.

• Reliable remote availability for approximately 15–20 hours/week.



SANITIZED PROJECT WORKFLOW

Work uses fictional or sanitized project information and approved references. Follow confidentiality, access, and revision-control requirements. Do not upload project material to unapproved services or subcontract the work. Deliverables are drafts subject to owner technical review and approval.



SELECTION PROCESS

1. Initial application and portfolio screening.

2. First technical engineering test using a fictional/sanitized problem.

3. Additional progressively harder technical tests for applicants who advance, to assess engineering judgment, integration, calculations, drawings, and work-package quality.

4. Live technical verification/interview: explain your submission and respond to a changed requirement.

5. Paid finalist trial before a hiring decision, with scope, rate, and time limit agreed in advance.

Only shortlisted applicants advance. Assessment instructions and time expectations will be provided at each stage. Submit your own work and disclose any tools or assistance used; you must understand and explain every technical conclusion.



PROBATION AFTER HIRE

The probation period is 3 months / 90 days, with formal review gates at Day 30, Day 60, and Day 90. Reviews assess technical accuracy, independent problem-solving, research/source quality, drawing and work-package quality, communication, productivity, and confidentiality. The final probation decision is at Day 90. Access remains limited to approved sanitized materials throughout.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply directly through this job posting on OnlineJobs.ph using the website’s application system. Use the subject: Telecom Engineer – [Your Name]. Submit your application and communicate through OnlineJobs.ph. Include:

1. Resume and relevant engineering education/experience.

2. One example of a technical problem or equipment upgrade you solved independently: the problem, your reasoning, and result.

3. Your AutoCAD experience and examples of drawings/work packages you personally produced, with all client/employer and sensitive information removed. Share only material you are authorized to share.

4. Experience with telecommunications, electrical/control interfaces, IP networks, and DC power systems.

5. Expected hourly rate, weekly availability, time zone, and earliest start date.

6. Confirmation that you are willing to complete the staged assessments, live verification, paid finalist trial, and 3 months / 90 days probation with formal 30/60/90-day review gates.



Please do not send confidential documents from current or former employers.

- Answer the community phone line on Dialpad. Warm, patient, unhurried.

- Take enquiries from people looking for a home. Answer their questions about

  availability, rent, pets, and the application, and book them a showing.

- Log every maintenance request and route it to the operations manager.

- Take payment questions and pass them on. You will not negotiate anything.

- Return every voi
 and text the same shift. No message sits overnight.

- Keep a simple call log so we can see what people are calling about.



WHEN THE PHONE IS QUIET - THIS IS THE IMPORTANT PART

This is not a job where you sit and wait. On a slow day you:

- Post and refresh our available homes on
 Marketplace, MHVillage,

  Craigslist and our Google Business Profile.

- Publish scheduled posts and photos from our marketing folder.

- Reply to comments and messages on our listings and social pages.

- Keep listing photos, prices and availability accurate and current.



All templates, photos, logos and captions are provided. You will have a written

content plan so you always know what to post next. You will not be waiting on

anyone for instructions.



WHO WE WANT

- 2+ years on the phone with US customers. Property management, hospitality,

  healthcare scheduling or inbound customer service all count.

- Clear, warm, easily understood spoken English. Neutral accent. You sound like a person, not a script.

- Genuine patience. Some callers are stressed about money or a broken water

  heater. You stay kind.

- Comfortable posting listings and basic social content from templates.

  Canva experience is a plus, not a requirement.

- You solve small problems yourself and ask about big ones. If you need someone

  to tell you what to do every hour, please do not apply - you will be unhappy.

- Reliable power and internet, and a quiet place to take calls. 



WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT

- You do not chase people for money or negotiate payment arrangements.

- You do not approve applications or make promises about repairs.

- You do not answer housing-assistance or fair-housing questions from memory.

  We give you an approved answer sheet, and anything not on it goes to Zo.

  We will train you on this properly in your first week.



SCHEDULE - PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

This is a NIGHT SHIFT. Our community is in the US Central time zone.

- Your hours: 9:00 PM - 6:00 AM Philippine time, Monday to Friday.

  (That is 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM in Arkansas.)

- One hour paid break inside the shift.

- We pay above market because we know what a night shift costs you. If the

  schedule does not fit your life, please do not apply - we want someone who

  is still here in two years.



COMPENSATION

TBD depending on experience. Paid twice monthly.

Bonus of USD 25 for every showing you book that becomes a signed lease.

We are looking for a long-term teammate, not a temporary one.





HOW TO APPLY - FOLLOW EVERY STEP

Applications missing a step are not read.

1. Begin your message with the word: MEADOWLARK

2. Record a 60-second voice message (any recorder, send a link) where you:

   - introduce yourself, and

   - pretend I am a caller asking "do you have any 2-bedroom homes

     available, and how much?" Answer me the way you would answer a real

     caller. You do not need to know our real prices - make them up.

3. In writing, 3-5 sentences: it is a slow night, the phone has not rung in

   three hours, and nobody has given you a task. What do you do?

4. Confirm you can work 9:00 PM - 6:00 AM Philippine time.

5. Describe your internet speed and where in your home you would take calls.

title: AI Video Creator, UGC & Short-Form Editor — Veo 3, Nano Banana, CapCut, Elevenlabs, ChatGPT
description:
AI Video Creator & Short-Form Editor — Veo 3, Nano Banana, CapCut, Elevenlabs, ChatGPT

Create health and wellness reels and UGC videos.



I run a fast-growing
 and Instagram health and wellness brand built around a consistent AI avatar, along with a growing network of additional social media pages.



I am looking for an **experienced AI video creator and editor** who can take a script and turn it into high-quality, realistic short-form content from start to finish.



**This is NOT a training role.**



You should already be comfortable working with the tools below and be able to start producing quality content with minimal hand-holding.



The three biggest things I care about are:



* **Following instructions exactly**

* **Making the videos look as realistic as possible**

* **Communicating clearly and consistently**



If I provide a reference video, avatar image, product image, editing example, or specific instructions, I expect those details to be followed closely.



## TOOLS YOU MUST ALREADY KNOW



### Veo 3 / Google Flow / Capcut / Elevenlabs



You should know how to:



* Generate high-quality, photorealistic AI videos from written prompts

* Create realistic human movement, expressions, gestures, and speech

* Maintain consistent characters between clips

* Create vertical short-form content ready for Instagram and

* Match the pacing, camera angles, movements, and overall feel of reference videos

* Troubleshoot poor generations and improve prompts without needing constant guidance



### Veo3 / Nano Banana



You should have strong experience with:



* Nano Banana 1

* Nano Banana 2

* Nano Banana Pro

* Veo3 

* Google Flow image generation and video generation

* Elevenlabs

*Capcut



You should understand when to use each model depending on the task.



You must be able to generate **hyper-realistic images** while maintaining:



* Consistent facial identity

* Accurate clothing

* Accurate products

* Realistic hands

* Realistic skin texture

* Natural lighting

* Correct proportions

* Consistent environments



The goal is for viewers to have difficulty immediately recognizing that the content is AI-generated.



### ElevenLabs



You should know how to:



* Generate realistic voiceovers

* Maintain the same voice across multiple clips

* Control pacing, tone, emotion, and delivery

* Make the voice match the avatar

* Avoid robotic or inconsistent speech



**Voice consistency between clips is extremely important.**



### CapCut



You should be highly comfortable editing short-form vertical content in CapCut.



You should know how to:



* Match a reference video's editing style closely

* Add and style captions

* Match fonts, placement, sizing, and timing

* Sync music properly

* Remove dead space

* Create tight cuts

* Color correct footage

* Match pacing

* Add overlays and product comparisons

* Make AI-generated footage feel like natural creator content



If I send you a reference video, you should be able to study it and recreate the editing style without needing every small detail explained.



---



# DAILY WORKFLOW



You will receive a script along with any necessary instructions, reference videos, avatar images, product images, or inspiration.



From there, you handle the entire production process:



**Script → Image Generation → Video Generation → Voice → Editing → Finished Video**



This includes:



1. Generating the necessary images with Nano Banana/Higgsfield

2. Creating realistic clips using Veo 3, Flow, HeyGen, or Grok

3. Keeping the avatar consistent

4. Keeping the voice consistent

5. Creating realistic product shots

6. Editing everything together in CapCut

7. Adding captions, music, overlays, and pacing

8. Delivering a finished vertical video that is ready to post



You must be able to deliver a **minimum of 6 finished videos per day**, approximately **5–6 days per week**.



Once you understand the format and style, the workflow is designed to be fast and repeatable.



---



# REALISM IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



I do not want videos that look like polished AI commercials.



Most of the content should feel like a real person casually filming on an iPhone.



That means paying attention to small details such as:



* Natural facial expressions

* Realistic blinking

* Natural hand gestures

* Realistic product handling

* Correct fingers and hands

* Slight camera movement

* Natural body movement

* Realistic lighting

* Accurate product packaging

* Consistent environments

* Consistent avatar appearance

* Consistent voice

* Natural speech pacing



You should notice these problems yourself and fix them rather than waiting for me to point out every issue.



---



# FOLLOWING INSTRUCTIONS



This is one of the most important parts of the role.



I will often provide very specific instructions about:



* Avatar appearance

* Clothing

* Store/location

* Camera angles

* Product placement

* Product images

* Dialogue

* Voice

* Editing

* Captions

* Reference videos

* Clip pacing



I need someone who actually reads everything carefully and follows those instructions.



If I say to use a specific reference product, store, avatar, voice, or editing style, I should not have to repeat it several times.



Attention to detail is extremely important.



---



# COMMUNICATION



You must be:



* Reliable

* Responsive

* Organized

* Easy to communicate with

* Comfortable asking a question when something is genuinely unclear

* Able to provide updates when needed

* Able to receive feedback without taking it personally

* Able to quickly correct mistakes



If there is a problem with a generation, missing asset, tool issue, or deadline, communicate it immediately instead of disappearing.



I am looking for someone I can work with consistently and trust with a high volume of content.



---



# WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



You should have:



* Proven hands-on experience with **Veo 3**

* Experience with **Google Flow**

* Experience with **HeyGen**

* Experience with **Grok**

* Strong experience with **Higgsfield**

* Deep familiarity with **Nano Banana 1, Nano Banana 2, and Nano Banana Pro**

* Experience with **ElevenLabs**

* Strong **CapCut** editing skills

* Strong prompt-writing ability

* Ability to maintain consistent AI characters

* Ability to generate realistic product shots

* Ability to recreate reference videos

* Ability to create completely new video concepts from scripts and inspiration

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to follow detailed instructions

* Strong attention to realism

* Strong communication

* High output capacity



You must be able to produce **4+ finished videos per day, 5–6 days per week.**



---



# WHEN APPLYING



Please include:



* Examples of AI videos you have personally created

* Examples using Veo 3

* Examples of Nano Banana/Higgsfield image generation

* Examples of realistic AI avatars

* Examples of short-form editing

* Examples showing realistic product placement or product handling if available



Also briefly explain which tools you use most often and your experience with:



**Veo 3, Google Flow, Nano Banana 1/2/Pro, Chatgpt, ElevenLabs, and CapCut.**



Please do not apply if you are still learning these tools.



I am looking for someone who can come in and **produce high-quality content from day one.**

title: Returns & Refunds Coordinator
description:

This is an important operational role: every return needs to be handled correctly, every refund needs to be accurate, and every issue needs to be followed through until it is solved.



Your Role



You will be responsible for making sure our returns and refunds process runs smoothly from start to finish.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Processing and monitoring customer returns

* Checking whether returned orders have been received and processed correctly

* Processing refunds accurately and on time

* Investigating missing, delayed or incorrect returns

* Handling refund discrepancies and exceptions

* Checking order, payment and return information across our systems

* Coordinating with Customer Service and our fulfilment partners

* Following up on unresolved return cases

* Maintaining a clear overview of outstanding returns and refunds

* Identifying recurring problems and reporting them to the team

* Helping improve and automate the returns process as we scale

What Success Looks Like



Your job is not simply to “process returns.”



We want you to make sure:



Returns don’t get forgotten.

Customers don’t wait unnecessarily.

Numbers remain accurate.

Problems are identified before they become bigger problems.

title: Architectural Stone CAD Drafter & Estimator
description:
Position: Architectural Stone CAD Drafter & Estimator



We are seeking an experienced CAD drafter and estimator who can transform architectural plans, designer renderings, elevations, and field measurements into accurate, fabrication-ready shop drawings for natural stone projects.



The ideal candidate understands natural stone slabs, wall cladding, flooring, countertops, large-format panels, fireplaces, exterior façades, and custom architectural stonework.



Primary Responsibilities



* Review architectural plans, designer renderings, specifications, and field measurements.

* Create detailed 2D and 3D shop drawings for client approval and fabrication.

* Develop elevations, sections, details, dimensions, joint locations, anchoring details, and installation layouts.

* Prepare slab-layout drawings showing how each piece will be cut from full slabs.

* Determine the number of slabs required for each project.

* Create accurate material takeoffs, cut lists, piece schedules, and square-foot quantities.

* Optimize slab usage to reduce waste while maintaining proper color and vein continuity.

* Lay out book-matched, vein-matched, and sequentially installed stone when required.

* Identify missing dimensions, conflicts, and constructability issues before fabrication.

* Coordinate drawing revisions with designers, architects, estimators, fabricators, and installers.

* Maintain organized drawing files, revision records, and project documentation.

* Assist the estimating department with labor, material, waste, and fabrication requirements.



Required Experience



* Strong proficiency in AutoCAD.

* Experience with SketchUp, Revit, Rhino, SolidWorks, or another 3D modeling platform.

* Previous drafting or estimating experience in natural stone, tile, countertops, architectural cladding, millwork, metal fabrication, glazing, or a similar fabrication industry.

* Ability to read architectural and structural plans.

* Strong understanding of dimensions, tolerances, joints, substrates, installation conditions, and fabrication limitations.

* Ability to calculate square footage, linear footage, piece quantities, slab requirements, and waste factors.

* Excellent attention to detail and ability to work independently.



Preferred Qualifications



* Direct experience creating natural-stone shop drawings and slab-cutting layouts.

* Experience with Slabsmith, Moraware, AlphaCAM, EasySTONE, or similar stone-industry software.

* Knowledge of marble, granite, quartzite, limestone, travertine, and thin natural stone veneer.

* Understanding of vein direction, slab sequencing, book matching, dry layouts, and material variation.

* Experience creating CNC-ready information is a plus.

* Familiarity with exterior cladding, mechanical fastening, adhered veneer, and large-format stone installation is highly desirable.



Required Work Samples



Applicants must provide examples of:



* AutoCAD shop drawings

* Architectural elevations and details

* Slab layouts or cutting diagrams

* Material takeoffs or cut lists

* Relevant 3D models or renderings



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who combines drafting ability with practical fabrication and estimating knowledge. This person should understand not only how to draw the project, but also how the stone will be selected, cut, matched, fabricated, delivered, and installed.

title: Construction Estimator / Drawing Reader - US Commercial Projects (Project-Based, Can Become Full-Time)

**RULE #1: READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE YOU APPLY.** There are three rules in this post. Rule #1 is right here. Rules #2 and #3 are further down. Applications that skip them will be deleted without a reply.



---



## About Us



On Site Contracting is a commercial general contractor in the United States (Ohio, Pennsylvania, West Virginia). We build ground-ups and fit-outs for business owners - franchisees and independent operators. We operate as a "paper GC": we don't self-perform, we coordinate the best subcontractors on every trade. That means accurate takeoffs and fast, clean sub outreach are the backbone of our business.



## What You'll Be Doing



- Read and interpret US commercial construction drawings - architectural, structural, MEP - plus specs and detail sheets

- Do full callouts and takeoffs by trade (demo, framing, drywall, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, flooring, millwork, finishes, fire protection, etc.)

- Build clean scope sheets/bid packages for each trade so subs know exactly what they're pricing

- Contact potential subcontractors, send them the scope and drawings, and chase them until we have real numbers back

- Track incoming bids, level them side by side, and flag gaps, exclusions, and anything missing from the drawings

- Report findings back in a clear, organized format we can price a job from



## Immediate Work



We have **two commercial restaurant remodels inside a strip plaza** that need to be estimated and priced ASAP. This is your first assignment, and it starts this week. Move fast and accurately on these and there is a lot more behind them.



## Requirements

- **Hands-on experience reading drawings for projects located in the United States.** This is non-negotiable. US plan sets, US trade standards, US terminology.

- Proven experience doing callouts/takeoffs and soliciting pricing from subcontractors

- Comfortable
ing and calling US-based subs and following up until you get a number

- Strong written English

- Able to work US Eastern Time hours when needed for sub follow-up

- Bluebeam, PlanSwift, On-Screen Takeoff, or similar - tell us what you use

- Reliable internet and the ability to start immediately



## The Arrangement



- Starts as **project-based** work, beginning with the two restaurant remodels

- Strong performance turns this into a **full-time position within 60-90 days**

- Rate: $5-10 per hour based on experience. Higher end for project-based work; lower end if/when this converts to full-time. First assignment is likely about 20-30 hours this week.



---



## HOW TO APPLY - READ CAREFULLY



There are three rules. All three are mandatory. If you miss any one of them, you will not be considered.



**RULE #1 - Read this entire post from beginning to end before applying.**



**RULE #2 - You must send in a video with your application.** No video, no interview. A phone camera is fine. We are not judging your production quality.



**RULE #3 - In that video, you must do two things:**



1. **State all three rules out loud** - Rule #1, Rule #2, and Rule #3.

2. **Tell us the exact experience and specific projects you have worked on in the United States** that you believe apply to this role and will help us. Name the project types, the trades you took off, the software you used, and what you were responsible for. Be specific. "I have 5 years of estimating experience" tells us nothing.



Keep the video under 5 minutes.



HOW TO SEND THE VIDEO (required):

1. Record on your phone.

2. Upload to Loom, Google Drive (anyone-with-link), or YouTube (unlisted).

3. Paste the full https link in your OnlineJobs application message / cover letter. Do not attach a huge video file. Do not say "I can send the video later." No link = automatic delete.



Example of what to paste:

Video: [paste your Loom or Drive or YouTube unlisted link here]



## Deadline



**All applications must be in by Monday, September 14, 9:00 AM Eastern Time.**

* Have previous experience in outbound sales, appointment setting, lead conversion or call-centre sales

* Are internally motivated and enjoy achieving measurable results

* Take initiative without needing constant direction

* Work with urgency and respond quickly to opportunities

* Are resourceful when your first approach does not work

* Follow through consistently

* You are uncomfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

* You give up after one or two unanswered attempts

* You need frequent reminders to complete follow-up

* You avoid asking someone to book

* You become easily discouraged by rejection

* You are focused only on completing your hours rather than producing results

* You require a completely fixed daily schedule



Schedule



This is a full-time remote position serving a clinic in Winnipeg, Canada.



You must have flexibility to work in scheduled calling blocks between approximately 7:00 a.m. and 8:00 p.m. Central Time, based on lead activity and when prospective patients are most likely to answer.



The schedule may include daytime, early-evening and limited weekend coverage. Specific hours will be discussed during the interview.



Technical Requirements



You must have:



* A reliable computer

* Stable, high-speed internet

* A quiet and professional calling environment

* A clear, reliable headset

* Backup internet and power options

* Reliable childcare (if applicable)

title: Appointment Setter B2B — $1,200 US per month + $50 per show-up
description:
Please just send us any message if you're interested, and we will send you a Google Form. All applications will be considered through the form.

Why strong setters join us

We built a role where your results are directly reflected in what you earn — with a guaranteed base, clear performance bonuses, and a team that genuinely invests in your growth. If you're experienced, consistent, and take your craft seriously, this is a place where you can build something real.

01 — Uncapped earning potential



Your compensation grows with your performance. The structure is transparent, the targets are achievable, and there's no ceiling on what you can earn each month.

You'll work closely with a team that knows this business inside and out. We share what's working, coach on what isn't, and help you sharpen your skills continuously — tone, objection handling, and conversation flow.

9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (ET)

Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset.

A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously. You'll know exactly what's expected, exactly what you'll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term.
